a: Haggalal ad tummo".
Amar mar: "veshillach" zo haregel, vechen hu omer: "meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor". tama dichtav rachamana "meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor", ha lav hachi – bemay mokmat la?
I keren – ketiv! i shen – ketiv!
Itzterich; salka datach amena: idde veidde ashshen, veha demikkalya karna, ha dela mikkalya karna; ka mashma lan.
Vehasheta deokemna aregel, shen dela mikkalya karna – menalan?
Dumeya deregel, ma regel – la shena mikkalya karna, vela shena la mikkalya karna; af shen – la shena mikkalya karna, vela shena la mikkalya karna.
Amar mar: "uvier" zo hashshen, vechen hu omer: "kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo". tama dichtav rachamana "kaasher yevaer haggalal ad tummo", ha lav hachi – bemay okemna la?
I keren – ketiv! i regel – ketiv! itzterich; salka datach amena: idde veidde aregel, ha deazel mimmela, ha deshallach shalloche; ka mashma lan.
Vehasheta deoke ashshen, regel deazla mimmela – menalan?
Dumeya deshen, ma shen – la shena shallecha shalloche, la shena deazel mimmela; af regel – la shena shallecha shalloche, la shena azla mimmela.

Velichtov rachamana "veshillach", vela bae "uvier"; demashma regel umashma shen – mashma regel, dichtiv: "meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor"; umashma shen, dichtiv: "veshen behemot ashallach bam"!
I lav kera yattira, hava amena: o ha o ha – o regel dehezzeko matzuy, o shen deyesh hanaa lehezzeko.
Mikkede shekulin hen, vayyavou shenehem – dehe minnayyhu mappekat? itzterich; salka datach amena: hane mille hechi deshallach shalloche, aval azla mimmela – la; ka mashma lan.
Tolada deshen may hi? nitchakkecha bechotel lahanaatah, vetinnefa perot lahanaatah.

May shena shen – deyesh hanaa lehezzeko, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name – yesh hanaa lehezzekan, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha! ella tolada deshen keshen, vechi kaamar rav pappa – attolada deregel.
Tolada deregel may hi? hizzika begufah derech hilluchah, bisarah derech hilluchah, bishlif shealeha, bifrumebya shebbefiha, bezog shebbetzavvarah.
May shena regel – dehezzeko matzuy, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name – hezzekan matzuy, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha! ella tolada deregel keregel, vechi kaamar rav pappa – attolada devor.
Tolada devor may nihu? illema av – asara, vetolada – tisha; la tisha ketivi, vela asara ketivi!
Ha la kashya; "vehammet yihye lo" amar rachamana, vekim lehu lerabbanan, asara – avdan mita, tisha – nezikin avdi, mita la avdi.
Sof sof, ze av lemita, veze av linzakin!
Ella aavno, sakkino umassao shehinnichan birshut harabbim vehizziku.
Hechi dame? i deafkerinhu – ben lerav uven lishmuel, hayeynu bor.
b: Vei dela afkerinhu – i lishmuel, deamar: kullam mibboro lamadnu, hayeynu bor; vei lerav, deamar: kullam mishshoro lamadnu, hayeynu shor!

May shena bor – shekken techillat asiyyayto lenezek, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name – techillat asiyyaytan lenezek, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha! ella tolada devor kevor, vechi kaamar rav pappa – attolada demave.
May nihu? i lishmuel, deamar: mave zo shen – ha okemna tolada deshen keshen. i lerav, deamar: mave ze adam – may avot umay toladot it beh?
Vechi tema: av – neor, tolada – yashen; vehatnan: adam muad leolam, ben er ben yashen!
Ella akkicho venio. hechi dame? i bahade deazli kamazzeki – kocho have! i batar denayaych – ben lerav ben lishmuel, hayeynu bor! ella tolada demave kemave. vechi kaamar rav pappa, attolada deesh.
Tolada deesh may nihu? illema avno, sakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo, venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku; hechi dame? i bahade deazlu ka mazzeki – hayeynu esh,

May shena esh – dechoach acher meorav bahen, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name – koach acher meorav bahen, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha! ella tolada deesh keesh, vechi kaamar rav pappa – attolada deregel.
Regel?! ha okemna tolada deregel keregel! bachatzi nezek tzerorot, dehilcheta gemiri la.
Veammay kare la tolada deregel? leshallem min haaliyyay.
Veha mibbaya bae rava – devae rava: chatzi nezek tzerorot – miggufo meshallem, o min haaliyyay meshallem?
Lerava mibbaya leh, lerav pappa peshita leh.
Lerava demibbaya leh, ammay kare la tolada deregel? lefotrah birshut harabbim.
Hammave vehahever kulei. may "mave"? rav amar: mave ze adam, ushemuel amar: mave ze hashshen.
Rav amar mave ze adam, dichtiv: "amar shomer ata voker vegam layla, im tivayun beayu".
Ushemuel amar mave ze hashshen, dichtiv: "ech nechpesu esav, nivu matzpunav". may mashma? kedimtargem rav yosef: echden itbelesh esav, itgallin matmorohi.
Verav, may tama la amar kishmuel? amar lach: mi katane "nive"?
Ushemuel, may tama la amar kerav? amar lecha: mi katane "boe"?
Mikkede kerae la kemar dayyki vela kemar dayyki, rav may tama la amar kishmuel? tena shor – vechol mille deshor.
Ushemuel name, ha tena leh shor! amar rav yehuda: tena shor – lekarno, umave – leshinno. vehachi kaamar: lo rei hakkeren – sheen hanaa lehezzeko, kiri hashshen – sheyyesh hanaa lehezzekah.

a: Velo rei hashshen – sheen kauonato lehazzik, kiri hakkeren – shekkauonato lehazzik.

Velav kal vachomer hu – uma shen, sheen kauonato lehazzik – chayyayv; keren, shekkauonato lehazzik – lo kol shekken? itzterich, salka datach amena: midde dehave aeved veama – eved veama, lav af al gav dechauonatan lehazzik, afillu hachi petiri? hachi name la shena.
Amar rav ashe: attu eved veama lav tama rabba it behu? shemma yaknitennu rabbo, veyelech veyadlik gedisho shel chavero, venimtza ze mechayyev et rabbo mea mane bechol yom!
Ella parech hachi: lo rei hakkeren – shekkauonato lehazzik, kiri hashshen – sheen kauonato lehazzik; velo rei hashshen – sheyyesh hanaa lehezzeko, kiri hakkeren – sheen hanaa lehezzeko.
Veregel may? shayyeyreh?! "keshehizzik chav hammazzik" – leetoye regel.
Velitneyeh behedya!

Ella amar rava: tena shor – leraglo, umave – leshinno. vehachi kaamar: lo rei haregel – shehezzekah matzuy, kiri hashshen – sheen hezzekah matzuy; velo rei hashshen – sheyyesh hanaa lehezzeko, kiri haregel – sheen hanaa lehezzeko.
Vekeren may? shayyeyreh?! "keshehizzik chav hammazzik" – leetoye keren.
Velitneyeh behedya! bemuadin mittechillatan kamayyre, betammin ulevassof muadin la kamayyre.
Ushemuel, may tama la amar kerav? amar lach: i salka datach adam, ha katane sefa: shor hammuad, veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak, vehaadam!
Velitne beresha! benizke mamon kamayyre, benizke gufo la kamayyre.
Verav name, ha katane adam besefa! amar lecha rav: hahu lemechsheveh bahade muadin hu daata.
Umay "lo hare"?
Hachi kaamar: lo rei hashshor – shemmeshallem et hakkofer, kiri haadam – sheen meshallem et hakkofer; velo rei haadam – shechayyayv bearbaa devarim, kiri hashshor – sheen bo arbaa devarim.
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen – sheddarkan lehazzik. vechi shor darko lehazzik?! bemuad. umuad – darko lehazzik?! kevan deiyyayad – orcheh hu.
Adam darko lehazzik?! beyashen. yashen darko lehazzik?! kevan dechayef ufashet – orcheh hu.
"Ushemiratan alecha"?! adam – shemirat gufo alav hu!
Uletamaych, ha detane karna: arbaa avot nezikin, veadam echad mehen; adam – shemirat gufo alav hu! ella kedaamar leh rabbi avahu letanna: teni: adam – shemirat gufo alav;
b: Hacha name, teni: adam – shemirat gufo alav.
Matkef la rav mari, veema "mave" ze hammayim, kedichtiv: "kikdoach esh hamasim, mayim tive esh"! mi ketiv "mayim nivu"?! "tive esh" ketiv.
Matkef la rav zevid: veema "mave" ze haesh, dechi ketiv "tive" – beesh hu dichtiv! i hachi, may "hammave vehahever"? vechi tema paroshe kamfaresh; i hachi, arbaa?! shelosha havu!
Vechi tema, tena shor deit beh tarte; i hachi, "la ze veze sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim" – esh may ruach chayyim it beh? vetu, may "kahare haesh"?
Tane rabbi oshaya, shelosha asar avot nezikin: shomer chinnam, vehashshoel, nose sachar, vehassocher; nezek, tzaar, verippuy, shevet, uvoshet; vearbaa dematnitin – ha telesar.
Vetanna didan – may tama la tane hane? bishlama lishmuel – benizke mamon kamayyre, benizke gufo la kamayyre; ella lerav, litne! tanna adam – vechol mille deadam.
Ulerabbi oshaya name, ha tane leh adam! tere gavvne adam; tena adam deazzek adam, vetanna adam deazzek shor.
I hachi, shor name, litne tere gavvne shor – litne shor deazzek shor, velitne shor deazzek adam!
Hay may? bishlama adam deazzek shor – nezek hu dimshallem, adam deazzek adam – meshallem arbaa devarim; ella shor, ma li shor deazzek shor, ma li shor deazzek adam; idde veidde nezek hu dimshallem.
Veha shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher, deadam deazzek shor hu, vekatane!
Tane hezzeka divyadayim, vekatane hezzeka demimmela.
Tane rabbi chiyyay, esrim vearbaa avot nezikin: tashlume chefel, vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vegannav, vegazlan, veedim zommin,
Vehaones, vehamefatte, umotzi shem ra, vehametamme, vehamedammea, vehamenassech; vehane telesar – ha esrim vearbea.
Verabbi oshaya – may tama la tane hane? bemamona kamayyre, biknasa la kamayyre.
Gannav vegazlan, demamona hu, litne! ha katane leh shomer chinnam vehashshoel.
Verabbi chiyyay name, ha tena leh shomer chinnam vehashshoel! tane mamona daata lideh behettera, vekatane mamona daata lideh beissura.

a: Edim zommin, demamona hu, litne! savar la kerabbi akiva, deamar: en meshallemin al pi atzman.
I savar leh kerabbi akiva, litne tere gavvne shor – litne shor deazzek shor, velitne shor deazzek adam;
Ditnan, rabbi akiva omer: af tam shechaval beadam – meshallem bammotar nezek shalem!
Ha tavreh rabbi akiva ligzizeh; detanya, rabbi akiva omer: yachol af tam shechaval beadam, yeshallem min haaliyyay – talmud lomar: "yease lo" – miggufo meshallem, veeno meshallem min haaliyyay.
Haones vehamefatte vehammotzi shem ra, demamona hu, litne!
Ma nafshach; i nezek – tena leh, i tzaar – tena leh, i boshet – tena leh, i pegam – hayeynu nezek. ma it lach lememar – kenasa? biknasa la kamayyre.
Hametamme vehamedammea vehamenassech, demamona hu, litne!
Ma nafshach; i hezzek sheeno nikkar shemeh hezzek – ha tena leh nezek, i hezzek sheeno nikkar la shemeh hezzek – have leh kenasa, uviknasa la kamayyre.
Lema kasavar rabbi chiyyay hezzek sheeno nikkar la shemeh hezzek? dei shemeh hezzek, ha tena leh nezek! tena hezzeka deminnachra, utena hezzeka dela minnachra.
Bishlama letanna didan, tena minyayna – lemaote derabbi oshaya, verabbi oshaya tena minyayna – lemaote derabbi chiyyay. ella minyayna derabbi chiyyay, lemaote may?
Lemaote moser umefaggel.
Velitne! bishlama mefaggel – bekadashim la kamayyre. ella moser, may tama la tane? shane moser – dedibbura, uvedibbura la kamayyre.
Veha motzi shem ra, dedibbura hu, vekatane! dibbura deit beh maase hu.
Veha edim zommin – dibbura delet beh maase hu, vekatane! hatam, af al gav delet beh maase, rachamana karyeh maase – dichtiv: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv".
Bishlama letanna didan, tanna "avot" – mikkelal deikka toldot; ella lerabbi chiyyay verabbi oshaya, "avot" – mikkelal deikka toldot?! toldotehen may nihu?
Amar rabbi avahu: kullan keavot leshallem mimmetav.
May tama? atya "tachat", "netina", "yeshallem", "kesef".
Lo hare hashshor kahare hammave. may kaamar? amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: hachi kaamar – lichtov rachamana chada, vetete iddach minneh; hadar amar: chada mechada la atya.
Velo ze vaze sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim. may kaamar? amar rav mesharsheya mishshemeh derava: hachi kaamar –
b: Lichtov rachamana tarte, vetete iddach minnayyhu; hadar amar: chada mittarte la ate.
Amar rava: vechullehu ki shadet bor benayyhu – atya kullehu bamme hatztzad, levar mikkeren; mishshum deikka lemifrach, ma lechullehu shekken muadin mittechillatan.
Uleman deamar: adderabba, keren adifa – shekkauonato lehazzik; afillu keren name atya.
Ella lemay hilcheta katvinhu rachamana? lehilchotehen.
Keren – lechallek ben tamma lemuedet.
Shen varegel – lefotran birshut harabbim.
Bor – liftor bo et hakkelim. ulerabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke chelim bevor – liftor bo et haadam.
Adam – lechayyeyvo bearbaa devarim.
Esh – liftor bo et hattamun. ulerabbi yehuda dimchayyev al nizke tamun baesh, leetoye may?

a: Leetoye lichacha niro vesichsecha avanav.
Hatztzad hashshave shebbahen. leetoye may? amar abbaye: leetoye avno sakkino umassao shehinnichan berosh gaggo, venaflu beruach metzuya vehizziku.
Hechi dame? i bahade deka azli ka mazzeki – hayeynu esh!
May shena esh – dechoach acher meorav bo, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name, koach acher meorav bahen, umamoncha ushemirato alecha!
Veella batar denayychi. i deafkerinhu – ben lerav ben lishmuel, hayeynu bor!
May shena bor – shekken techillat asiyyayto lenezek, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha; hane name, techillat asiyyaytan lenezek, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha!
Ella dela afkerinhu? lishmuel, deamar: kullam mibboro lamadnu, hayeynu bor!
Leolam deafkerinhu; vela damu levor, ma levor – shekken en koach acher meorav bo; tomar behane, shekkoach acher meorav bahen.
Esh tochiach!
Ma leesh – shekken darko lelech ulehazzik.
Bor tochiach! vechazar haddin.
Rava amar: leetoye bor hammitgalgel beragle adam uveragle behema.
Hechi dame? i deafkerinhu – ben lerav ben lishmuel, hayeynu bor;
May shena bor – shekken techillat asiyyayto lenezek, ushemirato alecha; hane name – techillat asiyyaytan lenezek, ushemiratan alecha!
Ella dela afkerinhu? lishmuel, deamar kullam mibboro lamadnu – hayeynu bor!
Leolam deafkerinhu; vela dame levor – ma levor, shekken maasav garmu lo; tomar behane, sheen maasav garmu lo.
Shor yochiach!
Ma leshor, shekken darko lelech ulehazzik. bor tochiach!
Vechazar haddin, lo rei ze chiri ze.

Rav adda bar ahava amar, leetoye ha detanya: kol ellu sheamru potkin bivotehen vegorfin mearotehen; bimot hachamma – en lahem reshut, bimot haggeshamim – yesh lahem reshut. af al pi shebbirshut, im hizziku – chayyayvim leshallem.
Hechi dame? i bahade dekaazli mazzeki, kocho hu!

Ella batar denayaych. hechi dame? i deafkerinhu – ben lerav ben lishmuel hayeynu bor; may shena bor – ditchillat asiyyayto lenezek, umamoncha ushemirato alecha; hane name – techillat asiyyaytan lenezek, umamoncha ushemiratan alecha!
Ella dela afkerinhu? lishmuel – deamar: kullam mibboro lamadnu, hayeynu bor!
Leolam deafkerinhu; vela dame levor – ma levor shekken shello birshut, tomar behane devirshut.
b: Shor yochiach!
Ma leshor shekken darko lelech ulehazzik.
Bor tochiach! vechazar haddin.

Ravina amar, leetoye ha ditnan: hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim, vehizziku – patur milleshallem. natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel, venaflu betoch hazzeman vehizziku – patur. leachar hazzeman – chayyayv.
Hechi dame? i deafkere, ben lerav ben lishmuel – hayeynu bor; may shena bor – dehezzeko matzuy, ushemirato alecha; hane name – hezzekan matzuy, ushemiratan alecha!
I dela afkerinhu, lishmuel deamar: kullam mibboro lamadnu – hayeynu bor!
Leolam deafkerinhu; vela dame levor, ma levor – shekken techillat asiyyayto lenezek; tomar behane – sheen techillat asiyyaytan lenezek.
Shor yochiach!
Ma leshor – shekken darko lelech ulehazzik.
Bor tochiach! vechazar haddin.
Keshehizzik chav hammazzik. "chav hammazzik"?! "chayyayv hammazzik" mibbee leh! amar rav yehuda amar rav: hay tanna yerushalmi hu, detane lishshana kallila.
Leshallem tashlume nezek. tanu rabbanan: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – metav sadehu shel nizzak, umetav karmo shel nizzak, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella ligbot lannizzakin min haiddit. vekal vachomer lahekdesh.
Verabbi yishmael, achal shemena – meshallem shemena; achal kechusha – meshallem shemena?!
Amar rav idi bar avin: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheachal aruga ben haarugot, vela yadinan i kechusha achal i shemena achal; dimshallem shemena.
Amar rava: uma illu yadinan dichchusha achal – la meshallem ella kechusha; hasheta, dela yadinan i kechusha achal i shemena achal, meshallem shemena?! hammotzi mechavero alav haraya!
Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shehayta iddit denizzak – kezibburit demazzik.
Uveha peligi – rabbi yishmael savar: bidnizzak shayyminan, verabbi akiva savar: bidmazzik shayyminan.
May tama derabbi yishmael? neemar "sade" lematta, veneemar "sade" lemala; ma sade haamur lemala – denizzak, af sade haamur lematta – denizzak.
Verabbi akiva, "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – dehaych deka meshallem.
Verabbi yishmael – ahani gezera shava, veahni kera; ahani gezera shava – kidkaamena.
Ahani kera – kegon deit leh lemazzik iddit vezibburit, veiddit lenizzak; vezibburit demazzik la shavya keiddit denizzak, dimshallem leh mimmetav dideh –
Dela matze amar leh: ta at gevi mizzibburit, ella gevi mimmetav.
Rabbi akiva omer: lo ba hakkatuv ella ligbot lannizzakin min haiddit, vekal vachomer lahekdesh. may "kal vachomer lahekdesh"?
Illema dingach tora didan letora dehekdesh, "shor reehu" amar rachamana – velo shor shel hekdesh!
Ella laomer "hare alay mane levedek habbayit", deate gizbar veshakel meiddit.
Lo yehe ella baal chov,

a: Uvaal chov bevenonit!
Vechi tema savar rabbi akiva: baal chov name beiddit; ikka lemifrach: ma levaal chov – shekken yippa kocho benizzakin, tomar behekdesh – shehora kocho benizzakin!
Leolam dingach tora didan letora dehekdesh. udeka kashya lach: "shor reehu" amar rachamana – velo shor shel hekdesh; rabbi akiva savar la kerabbi shimon ben menasya –
Detanya, rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: shor shel hekdesh shennagach shor shel hedyot – patur; shor shel hedyot shennagach shor shel hekdesh, ben tam ben muad – meshallem nezek shalem.

I hachi, rabbi yishmael verabbi akiva – mimmay dividdit denizzak vezibburit demazzik peligi? dilma dechulle alma bidnizzak shayyminan, vehacha biflugeta derabbi shimon ben menasya verabbanan kamippalgi –
Rabbi akiva savar kerabbi shimon ben menasya, verabbi yishmael savar kerabbanan!
Im ken, may "lo ba hakkatuv"?
Veod, may "kal vachomer lahekdesh"?

Veod, ha amar rav ashe, tanya behedya: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – metav sadehu shel nizzak, umetav karmo shel nizzak, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: metav sadehu shel mazzik, umetav karmo shel mazzik.
Rame leh abbaye lerava, ketiv: "metav sadehu umetav karmo yeshallem" – metav in, midde acharina la;
Vehatanya: "yashiv" – lerabbot shave kesef, vaafillu subbin!
La kashya; kan middato, kan beal korcho.
Amar ulla bereh derav illay: dayka name, dichtiv: "yeshallem" – beal korcho.
Amar leh abbaye: mi ketiv "yeshullam"?! "yeshallem" ketiv – middato mashma!
Ella amar abbaye: kidmar – detanya: hare shehayu lo battim sadot ucheramim, veeno motze lemochran – maachilin oto masar ani, ad mechetza.
Vehave bah mar: hechi dame? i (huzal) [dezul] arata dechulle alma, vedideh name zal bahadayyhu – afillu tuva name lispe leh, deha zul dechulle alma name!
Ella deokir arata dechulle alma, vedideh – ayyeyde deayel venafek azzuze, zal areh?
b: Afillu pureta name la lispo leh!
Veamar mar ala: la tzericha; divyome nisan yakra arata, uveyome tishre zal arata;
Dechulle alma – natri ad nisan, umezabbeni; vehay, hoil veitztericha leh zuze – zaven kidhashta. ad palga – orcheh lemezal, tefe – lav orcheh lemezal.
Vehacha name gabbe nizzakin – dineh beiddit;
Vei amar leh ihu: hav li benonit tefe pureta; amar leh: i shaklat kedinach – shekol kidhashta, vei la – shekoyl ki yukera dilkammeh.
Matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: im ken, horata kochan shel nizzakin etzel benonit vezibburit – derachamana amar mimmetav, veat amrat mibbenonit vezibburit name la!

Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov: i ikka ledammoye – levaal chov medammenan leh; baal chov – dineh bevenonit. vei amar leh: hav li zibburit tefe pureta, amar leh: i shaklat kedinach – shekol kidhashta, vei la – shekoyl ki yukera dilkammeh.
Matkef la rav acha bereh derav ika: im ken, naalta delet bifne lovin – deamar leh: illu havo li zuze, hava shekali kidhashta; hasheta dezuze gabbach, eshkol keyukera dilkammeh!

Ella amar rav acha bereh derav ika: i ikka ledammoye – lichtubbat ishsha medammenan; deha ketubbat ishsha dina bezibburit, vei amra leh ihi: hav li benonit betzir pureta; amar la: i shaklat kedinich – shekuli[10] kidhashta, vei la – shekuli keyukera dilkammeh.
Mikkol makom, kashya!
Amar rava: kol deyahev leh – mimmetav littev leh.
Veha "metav sadehu" ketiv!

Ella ki ata rav pappa verav huna bereh derav yehoshua mibbe rav, parshuha: kol mille – metav hu, dei la mizdabban hacha – mizdabban bemata achariti; levar meara – delittev leh mimmetav, ki hechi delikpotz ala zavona.
Bea minneh rav shemuel bar abba meakronya – merabbi abba: keshehen shamin – beshello hen shamin, o beshel olam hen shamin?
Allibba derabbi yishmael la tibbee lach, deamar bidnizzak shayyminan.
Ki tibbee lach allibba derabbi akiva – deamar bidmazzik shayyminan,
May? "metav sadehu" amar rachamana – lemaote denizzak; o dilma, lemaote dealma name?
Amar leh, rachamana amar: "metav sadehu", veat amrat beshel olam hen shamin?!
Etiveh: en lo ella iddit – kullam govin min haiddit. benonit – kullam govin benonit. zibburit – kullam govin zibburit.

Hayu lo iddit uvenonit vezibburit; nizzakin – beiddit, uvaal chov – bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha – bezibburit. iddit uvenonit; nizzakin – beiddit, baal chov uchetubbat ishsha – bevenonit. benonit vezibburit; nizzakin uvaal chov – bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha – bezibburit.

a: Iddit vezibburit – nizzakin beiddit, uvaal chov uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit.
Katane miha metzia: benonit vezibburit – nizzakin uvaal chov bevenonit, uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. vei amrat beshello hen shamin; tease benonit shello – keiddit, veyidche baal chov etzel zibburit!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shehayta lo iddit, umecharah.
Vechen amar rav chisda: kegon shehayta lo iddit, umecharah.
Hachi name mistabbera – middekatane achariti: benonit vezibburit – nizzakin bevenonit, baal chov uchetubbat ishsha bezibburit. kashyayn ahadade!
Ella lav shema minna: kan shehayta lo iddit umecharah, kan – shello hayta lo iddit umecharah?
Vei baet ema: idde veidde shello hayta lo iddit umecharah; vela kashya, ha deshavya benonit shello keiddit dealma, vechan dela shavya benonit shello keiddit dealma.
Veibbaet ema: idde veidde kegon shehayta benonit shello kevenonit dealma, vehacha beha peligi – mar savar: beshello hen shamin. umar savar: beshel olam hen shamin.

Ravina amar: bidulla peligi – deamar ulla: devar tora – baal chov bezibburit, shenneemar: "bachutz taamod, vehaish asher atta noshe vo yotzi elecha et haavot hachutza" – ma darko shel adam lehotzi lachutz – pachut shebbakkelim. uma taam amru baal chov bevenonit – kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin.
Mar it leh takkanta deulla, umar let leh takkanta deulla.
Tanu rabbanan: machar leechad o lishlosha bene adam keechad – kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim.
Beze achar ze – kullan govin min haacharon. en lo – gove mishshellefanav, en lo – gove mishshellifne fanav.
"Mecharan leechad" hechi dame?
Ilema bevat achat – hasheta lishlosha, deikka lememar chad minnayyhu kadem, amrat kullan nichnesu tachat habbealim; mecharan leechad mibbaya?
Ella peshita – beze achar ze.
Umay shena shelosha – dechol chad vechad amar leh: hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu;
Hay name – akkol chad vechad lema leh: hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon shellakach iddit baacharona. vechen amar rav sheshet: kegon shellakach iddit baacharona.
I hachi, leto kullehu veligbo meiddit!
Mishshum deamar lehu: i shatkitu veshaklitu kedinayychu – shaklitu, vei la – mahdarna shetara dezibburit lemareh, veshaklitu kullechu mizzibburit.
I hachi,
b: Benizzakin name nema hachi!
Ella hacha bemay askinan – beyatme, delav bene feraon ninhu, veshibuda dileh aleh dideh ramya;
Hilkach lekka lememar hachi.
Ella mishshum deamar lehu: tama may amur rabbanan en nifrain minnechasin meshuebadim bemakom sheyyesh bene chorin – mishshum takkanta didi; ana beha takkanta la nicha li.
Kidrava – deamar rava: kol haomer i efshi betakkanat chachamim kegon zo – shomin lo.
May "kegon zo"?
Kidrav huna – deamar rav huna, yechola ishsha shettomar levalah: eni nizzonet, veeni osa.
Peshita, machar lokeach benonit vezibburit, veshiyyer iddit lefanav – leto kullehu veligbo meiddit;
Deha acharona hi, uvenonit vezibburit letanhu gabbeh dematze lememar lehu: gevo mibbenonit vezibburit, dela nicha li betakkanta derabbanan.
Aval machar iddit, veshiyyer benonit vezibburit, may?
Sevar abbaye lememar: atu kullehu gavu meiddit.

Amar leh rava: ma machar rishon lashsheni – kol zechut shettavo leyado; vechevan deillu atu gabbe lokeach rishon – matze (agbe lehu) [leagboyinhu] mibbenonit vezibburit, veaf al pi dechi zavni[nehu l]venonit vezibburit akkatti iddit (bene) [bat] chorin havay – veen nifrain minnechasim meshuebadim kol zeman deikka bene chorin; matze amar lehu: la nicha li behay takkana;
Lokeach sheni name, matze amar lehu: geve benonit vezibburit. dechi zaven lokeach sheni, addata dechol zechuta dahava leh lerishon begavva zaven.
Amar rava: reuven shemmachar kol sedotav leshimon, vehalach shimon umachar sade achat lelevi, uva baal chov diruven; ratza – mizze gove, ratza – mizze gove. vela amaran ella dizvan benonit,
Aval zevan iddit vezibburit – la, daamar leh: lehachi deyayki uzevani iddit vezibburit, ara dela chazya lach.

Vaafillu zevan benonit name, la amaran ella dela shayyayr benonit dichvotay, dela matze amar leh: hinnachti lecha makom legabbe shimon. aval shayyayr benonit dichvotay gabbe shimon – la gave minneh, dematze amar leh: hinnachti lecha makom ligbot mimmennu.

Amar abbaye: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon beachrayut, vaata baal chov diruven uteraf mishshimon, dina hu deazel reuven umishtae dina bahadeh; vela matze amar leh: lav baal devarim didi at, deamar leh: i mappekat minneh – alay hadar.
Veikka deamri: afillu shello beachrayut name, deamar leh: la nicha li detehve leshimon taromet alay.
Veamar abbaye: reuven shemmachar sade leshimon shello beachrayut,

a: Veyatzu aleha asikin; ad shello hechzik bah – yachol lachazor bo, mishshehechzik bah – en yachol lachazor bo.
May tama? deamar leh: chayyta dekitre sevart vekabbelt.
Meemat havay chazaka? mikki dayesh ammitzre.
Vedavka shello beachrayut, aval beachrayut – la.
Veikka deamri: afillu beachrayut name, daamar leh: achvi tirfach vaashallem lach.
Rav huna amar: o kesef o metav.
Etiveh rav nachman lerav huna: "yashiv" – lerabbot shave kesef, afillu subbin!
Hacha bemay askinan – bidlet leh. i delet leh, peshita! mahu detema, amrinan leh: zil terach zabben, veayyti leh kesaf; ka mashma lan.
Amar rav assi: kesafim hare hen kekarka. lemay hilcheta? illema leinyan metav – hayeynu derav huna!
Ella lishne achim shechalku, venatal echad karka veechad kesafim, uva baal chov venatal karka; deazel hay, veshakel palga bichsafim bahadeh.
Peshita! hay bera vehay lav bera?!
Ikka deamri adderabba, leiddach gisa – daamar leh: lehachi shekali kesafim, dei migganvi – la mishtallamna minnach; ulehachi shaklat ara – dei mittarfa, la mishtallema lach midde minnay!
Ella lishne achim shechalku, uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen.

Veha amra rav assi chada zimna – deittemar: haachim shechalku, uva baal chov venatal chelko shel echad mehen, rav amar: batla machloket. ushemuel amar: vitter. verav assi amar: notel revia bekarka, urevia bemaot.
Rav amar: batla machloket – kasavar: haachim shechalku, keyorshim havu.
Ushemuel amar: vitter – kasavar: haachim shechalku lakochot, uchelokeach shello beachrayut dame.
Verav assi amar: notel revia bekarka urevia bemaot – mesappeka leh i keyorshin damu i kelakochot damu, hilkach notel revia bekarka, urevia bemaot!
Ella: may "hare hen kekarka" – leinyan metav.
I hachi, hayeynu derav huna! ema: vechen amar rav assi.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav huna: bemitzva – ad shelish.
May shelish?
b: Illema shelish beto, ella meatta, i itremi leh telata mitzvata – littev lechulleh beteh?!
Ella amar rabbi zera: behiddur mitzva – ad shelish bemitzva.
Bae rav ashe: shelish millegav, o shelish millevar? teku.
Bemareva amri mishshemeh derabbi zera: ad shelish – mishshello. mikkan veelach – mishshel hakkadosh baruch hu.
Mishna kol shechavti bishmirato – hichsharti et nizko. hichsharti bemiktzat nizko – chavti betashlume nizko kehechsher kol nizko.
Nechasim sheen bahen meila, nechasim shehen shel bene berit, nechasim hameyuchadim.
Uvechol makom, chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik,
Ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik.
Keshehizzik chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: kol shechavti bishmirato – hichsharti et nizko. ketzad? shor uvor shemmesaran lecheresh shote vekatan, vehizziku – chayyayv leshallem. ma sheen ken beesh.
Bemay askinan? ilema beshor kashur uvor mechusse, dichvota gabbe esh – gachelet; may shena hacha umay shena hacha?

Ella beshor muttar uvor megulle, dichvota gabbe esh – shalhevet; "ma sheen ken beesh" – defatur?! veha amar resh lakish mishshemeh dechizkiyya: lo shanu ella shemmasar lo gachelet – velibbah, aval shalhevet – chayyayv! may tama? deha bari hezzeka.
Leolam beshor kashur uvor mechusse, vedichvota gabbe esh – gachelet. udeka amrat: may shena hacha umay shena hacha?
Shor – darkeh lenattoke; bor – darkeh lenattore; gachelet – kamma deshavek la, mimay amya veazla.
Ulerabbi yochanan deamar: afillu masar lo shalhevet – name patur, dichvota hacha – beshor muttar uvor megulle; may shena hacha umay shena hacha?
Hatam – tzevata decheresh ka garem, hacha – la tzevata decheresh ka garem.
Tanu rabbanan: chomer beshor mibbevor, chomer bevor mibbeshor.

Chomer beshor mibbevor – shehashshor meshallem et hakkofer, vechayyayv bishloshim shel eved, nigmar dino – asur bahanaa, vedarko lelech ulehazzik; ma sheen ken bevor. chomer bevor mibbeshor – shehabbor techillat asiyyayto lenezek, umuad mittechillato; ma sheen ken beshor.

a: Chomer beshor mibbeesh, chomer beesh mibbeshor.

Chomer beshor mibbeesh – shehashshor meshallem kofer, vechayyayv bishloshim shel eved, nigmar dino – asur bahanaa, mesaro lecheresh shote vekatan – chayyayv; ma sheen ken beesh. chomer beesh mibbeshor – shehaesh muedet mittechillatah, ma sheen ken beshor.
Chomer beesh mibbevor, vechomer bevor mibbeesh.

Chomer bevor mibbeesh – shettechillat asiyyayto lenezek, mesaro lecheresh shote vekatan – chayyayv; ma sheen ken beesh. chomer beesh mibbevor – shehaesh darkah lelech ulehazzik, umuedet leechol ben davar harauy lah, uven davar sheeno rauy lah; ma sheen ken bevor.
Velitne chomer beshor mibbevor – shehashshor chiyyev bo et hakkelim, ma sheen ken bevor!
Ha manni – rabbi yehuda hi, dimchayyev al nizke chelim bevor.

I rabbi yehuda, ema sefa: chomer beesh mibbevor – shehaesh darkah lelech ulehazzik, umuede[400] leechol ben davar harauy lah uven davar sheeno rauy lah, ma sheen ken bevor. "davar harauy lah" may ninhu – etzim; "davar sheen rauy lah" may ninhu – kelim; "ma sheen ken bevor". i rabbi yehuda – ha amrat mechayyev haya rabbi yehuda al nizke chelim bevor!
Ella leolam rabbanan hi, utena veshayyayr. may shayyayr dehay shayyayr? shayyayr tamun.
Ibbaet ema: leolam rabbi yehuda, vedavar sheen rauy lah" lav leetoye kelim, ella leetoye lichacha niro vesichsecha avanav.
Matkef la rav ashe: litne chomer beshor mibbevor – shehashshor chiyyev bo shor pesule hammukedashin, ma sheen ken bevor!
I amrat bishlama rabbanan hi, ayyeyde deshayyayr hach – shayyayr name hach. ella i amrat rabbi yehuda, may shayyayr dehay shayyayr?
Shayyayr dash beniro. i mishshum dash beniro – lav shiyyura hu, deha[ka]tane: shekken darko lelech ulehazzik!
Hichsharti bemiktzat nizko.
Tanu rabbanan: hichsharti miktzat nizko – chavti betashlume nizko kehechsher kol nizko. ketzad? hachofer bor tisha, uva acher vehishlimo laasara – haacharon chayyayv.
Udela kerabbi – detanya: hachofer bor tisha, uva acher vehishlimo laasara – acharon chayyayv. rabbi omer: achar acharon lemita, achar shenehem linzakin.
Rav pappa amar: lemita, vedivre hakkol.
Ikka deamri: lema dela kerabbi? amar rav pappa: lemita, vedivre hakkol.
Matkef lah rabbi zera: vetu lekka? veha ikka: masar shoro lachamishsha bene adam, ufasha bo echad mehen – vehizzik, chayyayv.
Hechi dame? illema divlav ihu la hava minnetar, peshita deihu kaaved! ella divlav ihu name minnetar? may kaaved?
Matkef lah rav sheshet: veha ikka marbe bachavila!
Hechi dame?
b: I divlav ihu la azla – peshita! ella divlav ihu azla – may ka aved?
Matkef lah rav pappa, veha ikka ha detanya: chamishsha sheyyashvu al safsal echad velo shevaruhu, uva echad veyashav alav ushevaro – haacharon chayyayv. veamar rav pappa: kegon pappa bar abba.
Hechi dame? illema divlav ihu la ittevar – peshita. ella divlav ihu name ittevar – may kaaved?
Sof sof, matnita hecha mittartza?
La tzericha; divlav ihu have mittevar bitre shae, vehasheta ittevar bachada shaa; deamri leh: i lav at – have yatvinan tefe pureta, vekayymin.
Velema lehu: i lav attun – bedidi la hava mittevar!
La tzericha, devahade desamech behu, tevar.
Peshita!
Mahu detema, kocho – lav kegufo dame; ka mashma lan dechocho kegufo dame, dechol hecha degufo tavar – kocho name tavar.

Vetu lekka? veha ikka ha detanya: hikkuhu asara bene adam beeser maklot, ben bevat achat ben baze achar ze, vamet – kullan peturin. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer: beze achar ze – haacharon chayyayv, mippene shekkerav et mitato!
Biktala la kamayyre.
Veibbaet ema: biflugeta la kamayyre. vela?! veha okemnan dela kerabbi! dela kerabbi – ucherabbanan, mokminan; kerabbi yehuda ben betera – vela kerabbanan, la mokminan.
Chavti betashlume nizko. "chavti benizko" la katane, ella "betashlume nizko",
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: tashlume nezek – melammed shehabbealim mittappelin bannevela.
Mena hane mille? amar rabbi amme, deamar kera: "makke nefesh behema, yeshallemenna" – al tikre "yeshallemenna", ella "yashlimenna".
Rav kahana amar, mehacha: "im tarof yittaref yeviehu ed, hatterefa lo yeshallem" – "ad terefa yeshallem", terefa atzmah lo yeshallem.
Chizkiyya amar, mehacha: "vehammet yihye lo" – lannizzak.
Vechen tana deve chizkiyya: "vehammet yihye lo" – lannizzak. atta omer lannizzak, o eno ella lammazzik? amarta: lo kach haya.
May "lo kach haya"?
Amar abbaye: i salka datach nevela demazzik havya, lichtov rachamana "shor tachat hashshor", velishtok; "vehammet yihye lo" lema li? shema minna – lannizzak.
Utzericha; dei ketav rachamana "makke behema yeshallemenna" – mishshum dela shechicha; aval terefa, dishchicha – ema la; tzericha.
Vei ashmoinan terefa – mishshum demimmela; aval makke behema, divyadayim – ema la.
Vei ashmoinan hane tarte – ha mishshum dela shechicha, veha mishshum demimmela; aval "vehammet yihye lo" – dishchicha uveyadayim, ema la.
Vei ashmoinan "hammet yihye lo" – mishshum demamona ka mazzek; aval hacha, divgufa mazzek – ema la, tzericha.
Amar leh rav kahana lerav: ella tama dichtav rachamana "vehammet yihye lo", ha lav hachi hava amena: nevela – demazzik havya?
Hasheta i it leh ledideh kamma terefot – yahev leh, deamar mar: "yashiv" – lerabbot shave kesef, vaafillu subbin; dideh mibbaya?!
Lo nitzrecha ella lifchat nevela.
Lema pechat nevela tannae hi? detanya: "im tarof yittaref yeviehu ed" –

a: Yavi edim shennitrefa beones, ufatur. abba shaul omer: yavi aduda levet din.
May, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar: pechat nevela denizzak have, umar savar: demazzik have?
La, dechulle alma denizzak, vehacha betorach nevela kamippalgi;
Vehatanya, acherim omrim: minnayin sheal baal habbor lehaalot shor mibboro – talmud lomar: "kesef yashiv livalav, vehammet".
Amar leh abbaye lerava: hay torach nevela, hechi dame?
Ilema divvera shavya zuza, veaggudda shavya arba; ki tarach – bidnafsheh tarach!
Amar leh: la tzericha, divvera shavya zuza, veaggudda name shavya zuza.
Umi ikka kehay gavvna? in, deha amri inashe: keshura bemata bezuza, keshura bedavra bezuza.
Amar shemuel: en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan, ella lenizzakin. vaani omer: af leshoel. veabba mode li.
Ibbaya lehu: hachi kaamar – af leshoel shamin, veabba mode li; o dilma, hachi kaamar – vaani omer: af leshoel en shamin, veabba mode li?
Ta shema, dehahu gavra dishel narga mechavreh, tavre. ata lekammeh derav, amar leh: zil shallem leh narga mealleya. shema minna en shamin!
Adderabba, middeamri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: "dina hachi?!" ushetek, shema minna shamin.
Ittemar, amar ulla amar rabbi elazar: shamin legannav ulegazlan. rav pappe amar: en shamin. vehilcheta: en shamin lo legannav velo legazlan, aval leshoel shamin – kidrav kahana verav assi.
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah beyom rishon umiktzatah beyom sheni, monin lah min harishon.
Amar leh rava: ma datach, lechumera?!
Chumera deate lide kulla hu – deka metaharat la merishon!
Ella amar rava: lachosh – chosheshet; mimna la (40)manya ella lesheni.
May ka mashma lan – deen miktzat shilya belo valad? tenena: shilya sheyyatzta miktzatah – asura baachila; siman valad beishsha, siman valad bivhema!
I mimmatnita, hava amena
b: Deyesh miktzat shilya belo valad, ugezera miktzata attu kulla; ka mashma lan.
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: bechor shennitraf betoch sheloshim yom – en podin oto.
Vechen tane rame bar chama, mittoch shenneemar: "pado tifde", yachol afillu nitraf betoch sheloshim yom? talmud lomar: "ach" – chillek.
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: behema gassa niknet bimshicha.
Veha anan tenan bimsira! hu deamar – ki hay tanna: detanya, vachachamim omrim: zo vazo bimshicha. rabbi shimon omer: zo vazo behagebaha.
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: haachin shechalku, ma shealehen – shamin, uma sheal benehen uvenotehen – en shamin.
Amar rav pappa: peamim af ma shealehen en shamin – mashkachat la bigdol ache, denicha lehu delishtamun milleh.

Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar: shomer shemmasar leshomer – patur. vela mibbaya shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar – dealloye alleyay lishmirato; ella afillu shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam – dehashta garoe garay lishmirato, name patur, shehare masar leven daat.
Rava amar: shomer shemmasar leshomer – chayyayv. vela mibbaya shomer sachar shemmasar leshomer chinnam – degaroe garay lishmirato; ella afillu shomer chinnam shemmasar leshomer sachar – chayyayv,
Deamar leh: at mehemnat li bishvua, hay la meheman li bishvua.
Veamar ulla amar rabbi elazar, hilcheta: govin min haavadim.
Amar leh rav nachman leulla: amar rabbi elazar afillu miyyatme? la, minneh. minneh?! afillu miggelima deal katpeh!
Hacha bemay askinan – sheasao appoteke. kidrava, deamar rava: asa avdo appoteke, umecharo – baal chov gove hemennu. shoro appoteke, umecharo – en baal chov gove hemennu.
May tama? ha it leh kala, veha let leh kala.

a: Levatar dinfak, amar lehu ulla, hachi amar rabbi elazar: afillu miyyatme. amar rav nachman: ishtemitan ulla.
Hava ovada binhardea, veagbo dayyayne dinhardea. hava ovada befumebdita, veagbeye rav chana bar bizna. amar lehu rav nachman: zilu ahaduru, vei la – magbinan lechu leappadnayychu.
Amar leh rava lerav nachman: ha ulla, ha rabbi elazar, ha dayyayne dinhardea veha rav chana bar bizna; mar – keman sevira leh?
Amar leh: ana matnita yadana – detane avimi: perozbul chal al hakkarka, veeno chal al haavadim. mittaltelin niknin im hakkarka, veenan niknin im haavadim.
Lema ketannae –

Machar lo avadim vekarkaot; hechzik baavadim – lo kana karkaot, bekarkaot – lo kana avadim. karkaot umittaltelin; hechzik bekarka – kana mittaltelin, bemittaltelin – lo kana karka. avadim umittaltelin; hechzik baavadim – lo kana mittaltelin, bemittaltelin – lo kana avadim.
Vehatanya: hechzik baavadim – kana mittaltelin!
May, lav beha kamippalgi – demar savar: avadim kimkarkee dame, umar savar: avadim kemittaltelin dame?
Amar rav ika bereh derav amme: dechulle alma – avadim kimkarkee dame. vehadtanya kana – shappir; vehadtanya lo kana – baenan karka duvmya dearim metzurot bihuda" – dela nayydi.

Ditnan: nechasim sheen lahem achrayut niknin im nechasim sheyyesh lahem achrayut – bechesef, bishtar uvachazaka. menahane mille? amar chizkiyya, deamar kera: "vayyitten lahem avihem mattanot rabbot lechesef ulezahav ulemigdanot, im are metzurot bihuda".
Ikka deamri, amar rav ika bereh derav amme: dechulle alma – avde kemittaltelin dame. vehadtanya lo kana – shappir; ha detanya kana – beodan alav.
Vechi odan alav may have? chatzer mehallechet hi, vechatzer mehallechet – lo kana! vechi tema beomed, veha amar rava: kol sheillu mehallech lo kana – omed veyoshev lo kana!
Vehilcheta bechafut.
Vehatanya: hechzik bekarka – kana avadim!
Hatam beomdin betochah.
Mikkelal dehay "lo kana" – kesheen omdin betochah?
Hanicha lehach lishshana deamar rav ika bereh derav amme: avda kemittalteli dame; hayeynu dei omdin betochah – in, i la – la.
Ella lehach lishshana deamar: avda kimkarkee dame; lema li omdin betochah? ha amar shemuel: machar lo eser sadot beeser medinot, kevan shehechzik beachat mehen – kana kullan!
Velitamaych, lehach lishshana deamar: avda kemittaltelin dame; lema li omed betochah?
b: Ha kayyma lan dela baenan tzevurin!
Ella may it lach lememar – shane mittalteli denayydi mimmittalteli dela nayydi;
Hacha name, shane mekarkee denayydi mimmekarkee dela nayydi. avda – mekarkee denayydi hu, hatam – saddana deara chad hu.
Nechasim sheen bahen meila vechulei.
Meila hu delet behu, ha mikdash – kadshi;
Man tanna? amar rabbi yochanan: bekadashim kallim – veallibba derabbi yose haggelili, deamar: mamon bealim hu.
Detanya: "umaala maal baAdonai" – lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono, divre rabbi yose haggelili.
Vehatnan: hamekaddesh bechelko, ben bekodshe kodashim ben bekadashim kallim – enah mekuddeshet. lema dela kerabbi yose haggelili?
Afillu tema rabbi yose haggelili, ki amar rabbi yose haggelili – mechayyim, aval leachar shechita – afillu rabbi yose haggelili mode, dechi ka zachu – mishshulchan gavoah ka zachu.
Umechayyim mi amar? vehatnan: bechor, mochrin oto tam – chay (velo shachut), uvaal mum – chay veshachut. umekaddeshin bo et haishsha.

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: lo shanu ella bechor bazzeman hazze – dechevan dela chaze lehakerava, it lehu lechohanim zechiyyay begavveyhv; aval bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym – dachaze lehakerava, la.
Veetiveh rava lerav nachman: "umaala maal baAdonai" – lerabbot kodashim kallim shehen mamono, divre rabbi yose haggelili!
Umeshanne ravina: bivchor bechutza laaretz, veallibba derabbi shimon deamar: im bau temimim – yikrevu. im bau – in, lechattechilla – la.
Veim ita dechi amar rabbi yose haggelili mamono hu – mechayyim,

a: Lishanne: ha rabbi yose haggelili, ha rabbanan!
(Amar leh), mattenot kehunna kaamrat? shane mattenot kehunna, dechi ka zachu – mishshulchan gavoah ka zachu.

Gufa: "umaala maal baAdonai" – lerabbot kodashim kallim shehem mamono, divre rabbi yose haggelili. ben azzay omer: lerabbot et hashshelamim. abba yose ben dostay omer: lo amar ben azzay ella bivchor bilvad.
Amar mar, ben azzay omer: lerabbot et hashshelamim. lemaote may?
Illema lemaote bechor, hasheta uma shelamim – shetteunim semicha unesachim utenufat chaze vashok, amrat mamon bealim hu; bechor mibbaya?
Ella amar rabbi yochanan: lemaote maaser –
Kidtanya: bivchor neemar "lo tifde", venimkar tam – chay, uvaal mum – chay veshachut; bemaaser neemar "lo yiggael", veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut, lo tam velo baal mum.
Ravina matne la assefa – abba yose ben dostay omer: lo amar ben azzay, ella bivchor bilvad. lemaote may?
Illema lemaote shelamim, hasheta uma bechor – shekkadosh merechem, mamono hu; shelamim mibbaya?
Amar rabbi yochanan: lemaote maaser.
Kidtanya: bivchor neemar "lo tifde", venimkar tam – chay, uvaal mum – chay veshachut; bemaaser neemar "lo yiggael", veeno nimkar lo chay velo shachut, lo tam velo baal mum.
Ha bivchor bilvad kaamar! kashya.
Rava amar: may "nechasim sheen bahen meila" – nechasim sheen bahen din meila. umay ninhu – dehedyot.
Velitne dehedyot! kashya.
Amar rabbi abba: shelamim shehizziku – gove mibbesaran, veeno gove meemurehen.
Peshita, emurin legavoah salki!
La tzericha, legove mibbesaran keneged emurim.
Allibba deman?
I allibba derabbanan – peshita! ha amri ki lekka leishtallome mehay, la mishtallam mehay!
Vei allibba derabbi natan – ha amar: ki lekka leishtallome mehay, mishtallam mehay!
I baet ema: rabbi natan, ibbaet ema: rabbanan.
Ibbaet ema rabbanan – hane mille bitre gufe, aval bechad gufa matze amar leh: "mikkol hecha devaena – mishtallamna".
Ibbaet ema rabbi natan – hatam hu daamar leh baal shor levaal habbor: "ana toray beverach ashkachteh; may delet li leishtallome mehayech – mishtallaymna minnach";
b: Aval hacha, mi matze amar: "basar azzek, emurin la azzik"?!
Amar rava: toda shehizzika – gove mibbesarah, veeno gove millachmah.
Lechem – peshita!
Sefa itzterich leh – nizzak ochel basar, umitkapper mevi lechem.
Ha name peshita! mahu detema, kevan delechem hechshera dezevach hu – lema leh: at achlat besar, vaana ayyte lechem; ka mashma lan delechem chiyyuva divalim hu.
Nechasim shehen shel bene verit.
Lemaote may? i lemaote degoy – ha katane la lekamman: shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel goy – patur! tane vahadar mefaresh.
Nechasim hameyuchadin. lemaote may? amar rav yehuda: lemaote ze omer "shorcha hizzik", veze omer "shorcha hizzik".
Ha tane lekamman: hayu shenayim rodfin achar echad, ze omer: "shorcha hizzik", veze omer: "shorcha hizzik" – shenehem peturin! tane vahadar mefaresh.
Bematnita tana: perat lenichse hefker. hechi dame? illema dingach tora didan letora dehefker – man tava leh? ella dingach tora dehefker letora didan –
Lezil velayteh! beshekkadam vezacha bo acher.
Ravina amar: lemaote nagach veachar kach hikdish; nagach veachar kach hifkir.

Tanya name hachi, yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: afillu nagach veachar kach hikdish, nagach veachar kach hifkir – patur, shenneemar: "vehuad bivalav vehemit ish vegomer" – ad shettehe mita vehaamada baddin shavin keechad.
Ugemar haddin la baenan?! ha "hashshor yissakel" – bigmar din hu dichtiv!
Ella ema: ad shettehe mita vehaamada bedin ugemar din shavin keechad.
Chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik. deamar leh: torach birshuti may bae?
Ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik.

Amar rav chisda amar avimi: chatzar hashshuttafin – chayyayv bah al hashshen veal haregel. vehachi kaamar: "chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik" – defatur; "ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik – keshehizzik chav hammazzik".

Verabbi elazar amar: patur al hashshen veal haregel. vehachi kaamar: "chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik, ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik" name – patur; "ucheshehizzik chav hammazzik" – leetoye keren.
Hanicha lishmuel, ella lerav deamar: tena shor vechol mille deshor, "chav hammazzik" leetoye may?

Leetoye ha detanu rabbanan: "keshehizzik chav hammazzik" – lehavi shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher, shehizzika behema birshutan; tam – meshallem chatzi nezek, umuad – meshallem nezek shalem. nifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listin, veyatzta vehizzika – patur.
Amar mar: keshehizzik chav hammazzik – lehavi shomer chinnam vehashshoel nose sachar vehassocher. hechi dame?
Ilema deazzekeh tora demashil letora deshoel – lema leh: illu azzek bealma – baet leshallome at; hasheta deazzekeh letora didach, baena leshallome?!
Ella deazzekeh tora deshoel letora demashil – lema leh: illu ittazzak mealma – baet leshallome kulleh tora; hasheta deazzekeh tora didach, palga nizka hu dimshallemat li?!
Leolam deazzekeh tora demashil letora deshoel, vehacha bemay askinan – shekkibbel alav shemirat gufo,

a: Velo kibbel alav shemirat nezakav.
I hachi, ema sefa: nifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listim, veyatzta vehizzika – patur. ha bayyom – chayyayv? ha lo kibbel alav shemirat nezakav!
Hachi kaamar: im kibbel alav shemirat nezakav – chayyayv. nifretza ballayla o shepperatzuha listim, veyatzta vehizzika – patur.
Ini?! veha tane rav yosef: chatzar hashshuttafim, vehappunedak – chayyayv bahen al hashshen veal haregel. teyuveta derabbi elazar!

Amar lach rabbi elazar: vetisbera?! matneyata mi la peligi? vehatanya, arbaa kelalot haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer benizzakin: kol shehu reshut lannizzak velo lammazzik – chayyayv bakkol. demazzik velo lannizzak – patur mikkol.

Laze velaze, kegon chatzar hashshuttafim vehabbika – patur bah al hashshen veal haregel; al hannegicha veal hannegifa veal hanneshicha veal harvitza veal habbeita – tam meshallem chatzi nezek, muad meshallem nezek shalem.

Lo laze velo laze, kegon chatzer sheeno shel shenehem – chayyayv bo al hashshen veal haregel; al hannegicha veal hanneshicha veal hannegifa veal harvitza veal habbeita – tam meshallem chatzi nezek, muad meshallem nezek shalem.
Katane mihat, chatzar hashshuttafin vehabbika – patur bah al hashshen veal haregel;
Kashya ahadade!
Ki tanya hahi – bechatzer meyuchedet laze velaze ben leferot ben lishvorim. hahi derav yosef – bechatzer meyuchedet leferot, veenah meyuchedet lishvorim; dilgabbe shen – havya la chatzar hannizzak.
Dayka name – dekatane hacha dumeya defunedak, vekatane hatam dumeya devika; shema minna.
Matkef la rabbi zera: kevan dimyuchedet leferot?! ha baenan "uvier bisde acher", velekka!
Amar leh abbaye: kevan deenah meyuchedet lishvorim, "sede acher" karena beh.
Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: lema middematneyata la peligi, amorae name la peligi?
Amar leh: in. veim timtza lomar peligi – bekusheya derabbi zera uveferuka deabbaye peligi.
Gufa – arbaa kelalot haya rabbi shimon ben elazar omer benizzakin: kol shehu reshut lannizzak velo lammazzik – chayyayv bakkol.
"Al hakkol" la katane, ella "chayyayv bakkol" – bechulle[] nezek;
Manni – rabbi tarfon hi, deamar: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak, nezek shalem meshallem.
Ema sefa: lo laze velo laze, kegon chatzer sheeno shel shenehem – chayyayv bah al hashshen veal haregel.
May "lo laze velo laze"? illema lo laze velo laze kelal – ella deacher; veha baena "uvier bisde acher", velekka!
Ella peshita, lo laze velo laze – ella dechad; vekatane sefa: tam meshallem chatzi nezek, umuad meshallem nezek shalem;
Atan lerabbanan, deamri: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak, chatzi nezek hu dimshallem!
Resha rabbi tarfon, vesefa rabbanan?!
In; deha amar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, shevok matnitin veta abbatray – resha rabbi tarfon, vesefa rabbanan.
Ravina mishshemeh derava amar: kulla rabbi tarfon hi; umay lo laze velo laze – lo laze velo laze leferot, ella dechad; laze velaze lishvorim.
Dilgabbe shen – havya la chatzar hannizzak, legabbe keren – havya la reshut harabbim.
I hachi, arbaa?! shelosha havu!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak:
b: Shelosha kelalot – bearbaa[5] mekomot.
Mishna shum kesef, shave kesef. bifne bet din, veal pi edim – bene chorin, bene verit. vehannashim bichlal hannezek. vehannizzak vehammazzik betashlumin.
Gemara may "shum kesef"?
Amar rav yehuda: shum ze lo yehe ella bechesef.
Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: para shehizzika tallit, vetallit shehizzika para – en omrim: tetze para betallit vetallit befara, ella shamin otah bedamim.
"Shave kesef" –
Detanu rabbanan: "shave kesef" – melammed sheen bet din nizkakin ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut. aval im kadam nizzak vetafas mittaltelin – bet din govin lo mehen.
Amar mar: "shave kesef" – melammed sheen bet din nizkakin ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut. may mashma?
Amar rabba bar ulla: davar hashshave kol kesef. may nihu? davar sheen lo onaa. avadim ushetarot name en lahen onaa!
Ella amar rabba bar ulla: davar hannikne bechesef. avadim ushetarot name niknin bechesef!
Ella amar rav ashe: "shave kesef" – velo kesef, vehane kullehu kesef ninhu.

Rame leh rav yehuda bar chinnana lerav huna bereh derav yehoshua, tana: "shave kesef" – melammed sheen bet din nizkakin ella linchasim sheyyesh lahen achrayut. vehatanya: "yashiv" – lerabbot shave kesef, vaafillu subbin!
Hacha bemay askinan – beyatme.
I beyatme, ema sefa: im kadam nizzak vetafas mittaltelin – bet din govin lo mehen. i beyatme, ammay bet din govin lo mehen?
Kidamar rava amar rav nachman: shettafas mechayyim; hacha name – shettafas mechayyim.
"Bifne bet din" –
Perat lemocher nechasav veachar kach holech levet din.
Shema minna – lava umachar nechasav, veachar kach ba levet din, en bet din govin lo mehen?!
Ella perat levet din hedyotot.
"Al pi edim" –
Perat lemode biknas veachar kach bau edim, shehu patur.
Hanicha leman deamar: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – patur. ella leman deamar: mode biknas veachar kach bau edim – chayyayv, may ikka lememar?
Sefa itzterich leh –

a: "Bene chorin uvene verit". "bene chorin" – lemaote avadim, "bene verit" – lemaote goyim.
Utzericha; dei ashmeinan eved – mishshum deen lo chayis, aval goy – deyesh lo chayis, ema la; vei ashmeinan goy – mishshum dela shayech bemitzvot, aval eved – deshayech bemitzvot, ema la; tzericha.
Vehannashim bichlal hannezek. menahane mille?
Amar rav yehuda amar rav, vechen tana deve rabbi yishmael, amar kera: "ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot" – hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol onashin shebbattora.
Deve rabbi elazar tana: "veelle hammishpatim asher tasim lifnehem" – hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol dinin shebbattora.
Deve chizkiyya verabbi yose haggelili tana, amar kera: "vehemit ish o ishsha" – hishva hakkatuv ishsha leish lechol mitot shebbattora.
Utzerichi; dei ashmeinan kammayyta – hatam hu dechas rachamana ala, ki hechi detehve la kappara; aval dinin – ish, devar massa umattan – in, ishsha – la.
Vei ashmeinan dinin – ki hechi detihve la chayyuta; aval kappara – ish, devar mitzva – in; ishsha, delav bat mitzva – la.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte – hacha mishshum kappara, vehacha mishshum chayyuta; aval leinyan ketala – ish, devar mitzva – leshallem kofer; ishsha – la.
Vei ashmeinan kofer – mishshum deikka ibbud neshama; aval hane tarte, delekka ibbud neshama – ema la; tzericha.
Hannizzak vehammazzik betashlumin.
Ittemar: palga nizka – rav pappa amar: mamona, rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: kenasa.
Rav pappa amar mamona – kasavar: setam shevorim lav bechezkat shimmur kayymi, uvedin hu devae leshallome kulleh; verachamana hu dechas aleh, deakkatti la iyyayad toreh.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar kenasa – kasavar: setam shevorim bechezkat shimmur kayymi, uvedin hu dela leshallem kelal; verachamana hu dekanseh, ki hechi delintereh letoreh.

Tenan: hannizzak vehammazzik betashlumin. bishlama leman deamar palga nizka mamona – hayeynu deshayech nizzak betashlumin; ella leman deamar palga nizka kenasa – hasheta delav dideh shakel, betashlumin iteh?!
Lo nitzrecha ella lifchat nevela.
Pechat nevela – ha tena leh resha: "tashlume nezek" – melammed shehabbealim mittappelin binvela!
Chada betam, vachada bemuad.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan tam – mishshum deakkatti la iyyayad, aval muad ema la. vei ashmeinan muad – mishshum deka meshallem kulleh, aval tam ema la; tzericha.
Ta shema: ma ben tam lemuad? shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek – miggufo, umuad meshallem nezek shalem – min haaliyyay.
Veim ita, litne name ha – tam eno meshallem al pi atzmo, muad meshallem al pi atzmo!
Tena veshayyayr. may shayyayr dehay shayyayr?
Shayyayr chatzi chofer.
I mishshum chatzi chofer – lav shiyyura hu; ha manni – rabbi yose haggelili hi, deamar: tam meshallem chatzi chofer.
Ta shema:
b: "Hemit shori et peloni" o "shoro shel peloni" – hare ze meshallem al pi atzmo.
May, lav betam?
La, bemuad. aval tam may – hachi name deen meshallem al pi atzmo? i hachi, addetane sefa "hemit shori et avdo shel peloni" – en meshallem al pi atzmo, liflog velitne bedideh:
Bamme devarim amurim – bemuad, aval betam – eno meshallem al pi atzmo!
Kullah bemuad kamayyre.
Ta shema: ze hakkelal, kol hameshallem yoter al ma shehizzik – eno meshallem al pi atzmo. may, lav ha pachot mimma shehizzik – meshallem?
La, ha kema shehizzik – meshallem.

Aval pachot may – hachi name dela meshallem? i hachi, addetane: ze hakkelal, kol hameshallem yoter al ma shehizzik – eno meshallem al pi atzmo; litne: ze hakkelal, kol sheeno meshallem kema shehizzik – demashma pachot, umashma yoter! teyuveta.
Vehilcheta: palga nizka – kenasa.
Teyuveta vehilcheta?!
In, tama may havya teyuveta – mishshum dela katane kemo shehizzik;
La pesika leh. kevan deikka chatzi nezek tzerorot, dehilcheta gemiri la demamona hu; mishshum hachi la katane.
Vehasheta deamrat palga nizka kenasa, hay kalba daachal immere, veshunnara daachalo tarnegola – meshunne hu, vela magbenan bevavel.
Vehane mille beravreve, aval bezutere – orcheh hu.
Vei tefas – la mappekinan minneh.
Vei amar: kivu li zimna, deazelna leara deyisrael – kavinan leh. vei la azel – meshammetinan leh.
Uven kach uven kach, meshammetinan leh ad dimsallek hezzeka –
Midderabbi natan. detanya, rabbi natan omer: minnayin shello yegaddel adam kelev ra betoch beto, veal yaamid sullam raua betoch beto? talmud lomar: "lo tasim damim bevetecha".
Mishna chamishsha tammin vachamishsha muadin –
Habbehema enah muedet lo liggach, velo liggof, velo lishshoch, velo lirbotz, velo livot.
Hashshen – muedet leechol et harauy lah; haregel – muedet lishbor bederech hilluchah; veshor hammuad; veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak; vehaadam.
Hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash – hare ellu muadin. rabbi elazar omer: bizman shehen bene tarbut – enan muadin. vehannachash muad leolam.
Gemara middekatane hashshen muedet leechol – mikkelal devachatzar hannizzak askinan; vekatane behema enah muedet leshallem kulleh – aval chatzi nezek meshallemet,
Manni – rabbanan hi, deamri: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak, chatzi nezek hu dimshallem.
Ema sefa: shor hammuad, veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak, vehaadam – atan lerabbi tarfon, deamar: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak, nezek shalem hu dimshallem!
Resha rabbanan, vesefa rabbi tarfon?!
In, dehaamar leh shemuel lerav yehuda: shinnana, shevok matnitin veta abbatray – resha rabbanan vesefa rabbi tarfon.
Rabbi elazar mishshemeh derav amar:

a: Kulla rabbi tarfon hi; resha – bechatzer hameyuchedet leferot leechad mehen, velaze velaze lishvarim; dilgabbe shen havya la chatzar hannizzak. ulegabbe keren havya reshut harabbim.

Amar rav kahana: amrita lishmata kammeh derav zevid minnehardea, vaamar li: mi matzet mokmat la kulla kerabbi tarfon?! hakatane: "hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah"; rauy lah – in, sheen rauy lah – la;
Vei rabbi tarfon, haamar: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak nezek shalem meshallem!
Ella leolam rabbanan hi; vechassore mechassera, vehachi katane: chamishsha tammim hen, veim huadu – chamishtan muadin.
Veshen varegel muadin mittechillatan. vehechan headatan? bachatzar hannizzak.
Matkef la ravina, ha katane lekamman: "shor hammazzik birshut hannizzak ketzad". i amrat bishlama ayyri ba, mishshum hachi katane "ketzad". ella i amrat la ayyri ba, may "ketzad"?
Ella amar ravina: chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: chamishsha tammim hen. veim huadu – chamishtan muadin;

Veshen varegel – muadin mittechillatan; vezehu shor hammuad. veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak – machloket rabbi tarfon verabbanan. veyesh muadim acherim kayyotze beellu – hazzeev, vehaari, vehaddov, vehabbardelas, vehannamer, vehannachash.

Tanya name hachi: chamishsha tammim hen. veim huadu – chamishtan muadin; veshen varegel – muadin mittechillatan; vezehu shor hammuad. veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak – machloket rabbi tarfon verabbanan. veyesh muadin acherim kayyotze beellu – hazzeev, vehaari, haddov, vehannamer, vehabbardelas, vehannachash.
Ikka deramu la mirma – tenan: chamishsha tammim vachamishsha muadim. vetu lekka?! vehaikka hazzeev, haari, vehaddov, vehannamer, vehabbardelas, vehannachash!

Umeshanne, amar ravina: chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: chamishsha tammim hen. veim huadu – chamishtan muadin; veshen varegel muadin mittechillatan; vezehu shor hammuad. veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak – machloket rabbi tarfon verabbanan. veyesh muadin acherim kayyotze beellu – hazzeev, vehaari, haddov, vehannamer, vehabbardelas, vehannachash.
Velo lirbotz. amar rabbi elazar: lo shanu ella pakkin gedolim, aval pakkin ketannim – orcheh hu.
Lema mesayyay leh: habbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah, uleshabber ulemaech et haadam veet habbehema veet hakkelim.
Dilma min hatztzad.
Ikka deamri, amar rabbi elazar: la tema pakkin gedolim hu delav orcheh, aval pakkin ketannim orcheh hu; ella afillu pakkin ketannim name lav orcheh hu.
Metivi: ulemaech et haadam veet habbehema veet hakkelim!
Amar rabbi elazar: dilma min hatztzad.
Ikka derame la mirma – tenan: velo lirbotz. vehatanya: ulemaech et haadam veet habbehema veet hakkelim! amar rabbi elazar: la kashya; kan befakkin gedolim, kan befakkin ketannim.
Hazzeev vehaari vechulei. may bardelas? amar rav yehuda: nafreza. may nafreza? amar rav yosef: appa.
Metivi, rabbi meir omer: af hatztzavoa. rabbi elazar omer: af hannachash. veamar rav yosef: tzavoa zo appa!
La kashya, kan betzavoa zachar, kan betzavoa nekiva.

Detanya: tzavoa zachar leachar sheva shanim naase atallef, atallef leachar sheva shanim naase arpad, arpad leachar sheva shanim naase kimmos, kimmos leachar sheva shanim naase choach, choach leachar sheva shanim naase shed. shidro shel adam – leachar sheva shanim naase nachash. vehane mille dela kara bemodim".
Amar mar, rabbi meir omer: af hatztzavoa.
b: Rabbi elazar omer: af hannachash. veha anan tenan, rabbi elazar omer: bizman shehen bene tarbut – enan muadim; vehannachash muad leolam!
Teni: nachash.
Amar shemuel: ari birshut harabbim; daras veachal – patur. taraf veachal – chayyayv.
Daras veachal patur – kevan deorcheh lemidras, have leh kemo sheachla perot virakot, dehave leh shen birshut harabbim, ufatur. taraf – lav orcheh hu.

Lememra ditrefa lav orcheh hu? vehachtiv "arye toref bede gorotav"! bishvil gorotav. "umechannek lelivotav"! bishvil livotav. "vaymalle teref chorav"! bishvil chorav. "umeonotav terefa"! bishvil meonotav.
Vehatanya: vechen chayya shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak, tarfa behema veachla basar – meshallem nezek shalem!
Hacha bemay askinan – shettarfa lehanniach. ha "achla" katane! beshennimlecha veachla.
Mena yadinan? veod, dishmuel name – dilma hachi hu?
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, litzdadin katane: shettarfa lehanniach, o darsa veachla – meshallemet nezek shalem.
Ravina amar: ki kaamar shemuel – baari tarbut, veallibba derabbi elazar – deamar: lav orcheh.
I hachi, afillu darsa name lichayyayv!
Ella deravina lav ashshemuel ittemar, ella ammatnita; ki tane matnita – baari tarbut, veallibba derabbi elazar deamar: lav orcheh.
I hachi, chatzi nezek bae leshallome! deiyyayad.
I hachi, may hay dekatane la gabbe tolada deshen? gabbe tolada dekeren bae lemitneyay! kashya.
Mishna ma ben tam lemuad?
Ella shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo, umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyyay.
Gemara may "aliyyay"? amar rabbi elazar: bimulle shebbinchasav.
Vechen hu omer: "vayyishkav chizkiyyahu im avotav, vayyikberuhu bemaale kivre vene david", veamar rabbi elazar: "bemaale" – etzel meullim shebbammishpacha, uman ninhu – david ushelomo.

"Vayyikberuhu vekivrotav asher kara lo beir david, vayyashkivuhu bammishkav asher mille besamim uzenim" – may "besamim uzenim"? rabbi elazar amar: zeyne zeyne. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: besamim shekkol hammeriach bahen ba lide zimma.
"Ki charu shucha lelochdeni, ufachim tamnu leraglay" – rabbi elazar amar: shechashaduhu mizzona. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: shechashaduhu meeshet ish.
Bishlama leman deamar shechashaduhu mizzona – hayeynu dichtiv: "ki shucha amukka zona". ella leman deamar shechashaduhu meeshet ish, may "shucha"? attu eshet ish mi nafka mikkelal zona?

Bishlama leman deamar shechashaduhu meeshet ish – hayeynu dichtiv: "veatta Adonai yadata et kol atzatam alay lammavet". ella leman deamar shechashaduhu mizzona, may "lammavet"? shehishlichuhu liver tit.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "yihyu muchshalim lefanecha, beet appecha ase bahem"? amar yirmeya lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, afillu beshaa sheosin tzedaka – hacheshilem bivne adam sheenan mehugganim, kede shello yekabbelu alehen sachar.
"Vechavod asu lo vemoto" – melammed shehoshivu yeshiva al kivro.
Peligi ba rabbi natan verabbanan, chad amar shelosha,

a: Vechad amar shiva. veamri la: sheloshim.
Tanu rabbanan: "vechavod asu lo vemoto" – ze chizkiyya melech yehuda, sheyyatzu lefanav sheloshim veshishsha elef chalutze chatef, divre rabbi yehuda.
Amar lo rabbi nechemya: vahalo lifne achav asu ken!
Ella shehinnichu sefer tora al mittato, veamru: kiyyem ze ma shekkatuv baze.
Vehaiddana name avdinan hachi! appoke mappekinan, annoche la mannechinan. veibbaet ema: annoche name mannechinan, "kiyyem" la amrinan.

Amar rabba bar bar chana: hava azelna bahadeh derabbi yochanan lemishal shemata, ki hava ayel levet hakkisse vahava baena minneh milleta, la pashet lan ad demashe yedeh umannach tefillin umevarech, vahadar amar lan: afillu "kiyyem" amrinan; "limmed" la amrinan.
Vehaamar mar: gadol talmud tora, shehattalmud mevi lide maase! la kashya; ha lemigmar, ha leagmore.

Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, may dichtiv: "ashrechem zore al kol mayim, meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor"? kol haosek betora uvigmilut chasadim, zoche lenachalat shene shevatim.
Shenneemar: "ashrechem zore" – veen "zeria" ella tzedaka, shenneemar: "ziru lachem litzdaka vekitzru lefi chesed"; veen "mayim" ella tora, shenneemar: "hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim".
Vezoche lenachalat shene shevatim – zoche lechila keyosef, dichtiv: "ben porat yosef, banot tzaada ale shur"; vezoche lenachalat yissashchar, dichtiv: "yissashchar chamor garem".

It deamri: oyvav noflim lefanav keyosef – dichtiv: "bahem ammim yenaggach yachdav afse aretz"; vezoche levina keyissashochar – dichtiv: "umibbene yissashchar yode vina laittim, ladaat ma yaase yisrael".
Hadaran alaych arbaa avot
Mishna ketzad haregel muedet? lishbor bederech hilluchah. habbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah uleshabber.

Hayta mevaetet, o shehayu tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha – veshavra et hakkelim, meshallem chatzi nezek. darsa al hakkeli ushevarattu, venafal al keli ushevaro – al harishon meshallem nezek shalem, veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek.
Hattarnegolin muadin lehallech kedarkan uleshabber. haya delil kashur beraglav, o shehaya mehaddes umeshabber et hakkelim – meshallem chatzi nezek.
b: Gemara amar leh ravina lerava: hayeynu regel hayeynu behema! amar leh: tena avot, vekatane toladot.
Ella meatta, sefa dekatane: "hashshen muedet" "habbehema muedet", may avot umay toladot ikka? hava kamahdar leh bivdichuta, vaamar leh: ana shannay chada, veat shanni chada.
Vetama may? amar rav ashe: tanna shen dechayya, vekatane shen divhema. salka datach amena: "veshillach et beiro" ketiv, behema – in, chayya – la; ka mashma lan dechayya bichlal behema.
I hachi, ha mibbee leh lemitne beresha! hay deatya leh midderasha – chaviva leh.
I hachi, resha name – litne hahi dela ketiva beresha! hachi hasheta?! hatam – idde veidde avot ninhu, hach deatya leh midderasha – chaviva leh. hacha – shavek av, vetane tolada?!
Ibbaet ema: ayyeyde desalek meregel, patach baregel.

Tanu rabbanan: behema muedet lehallech kedarkah uleshabber. ketzad? behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak – vehizzika begufah derech hilluchah, uvisarah derech hilluchah; baukkaf shealeha, uvishlif shealeha, uvifrumebya shebbefiha, uvezog shebbetzavvarah; vachamor bemassao – meshallem nezek shalem. somchos omer: tzerorot, vachazir shehaya nover baashpa vehizzik – meshallem nezek shalem.
Hizzik – peshita! ella ema: hittiz vehizzik – meshallem nezek shalem.

Tzerorot man dechar shemayhu? chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: tzerorot ki orchayyhu – chatzi nezek. vachazir shehaya nover baashpa, vehittiz vehizzik – meshallem chatzi nezek. somchos omer: tzerorot, vachazir shehaya nover baashpa vehittiz vehizzik – meshallem nezek shalem.

Tanu rabbanan: tarnegolin shehayu mafrichin mimmakom lemakom, veshavru kelim bechanfehen – meshallem nezek shalem. beruach shebbechanfehen – meshallemin chatzi nezek. somchos omer: nezek shalem. tanya iddach: tarnegolin shehayu mehaddesin al gabbe issa veal gabbe perot, vetinnefu o nikkeru – meshallem nezek shalem. heelu afar o tzerorot – meshallemin chatzi nezek. somchos omer: nezek shalem.
Tanya iddach: tarnegol shehaya mafriach mimmakom lemakom, veyatzta ruach mittachat kenafav veshibbera et hakkelim – meshallem chatzi nezek. setama kerabbanan.
Amar rava: bishlama somchos – kasavar: kocho kegufo dame. ella rabbanan, i kegufo dame – kulleh nezek bae leshallem; vei lav kegufo dame, chatzi nezek name la leshallem!
Hadar amar rava: leolam kegufo dame, vachatzi nezek tzerorot – hilcheta gemiri la.
Amar rava: kol shebbazzav tame – benizzakin meshallem nezek shalem. kol shebbazzav tahor – benizzakin meshallem chatzi nezek.
Verava, tzerorot ata leashmoinan?! lo; rava – egla moshechet bakkaron ka mashma lan.

Tanya kevateh derava: behema muedet leshabber bederech hilluchah. ketzad? behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak – vehizzika begufah derech hilluchah, uvisarah derech hilluchah; baukkaf shealeha, uvishlif shealeha, uvifrumebya shebbefiha, uvezog shebbetzavvarah; vachamor bemassao, veegla moshechet bekaron – meshallem nezek shalem.
Tanu rabbanan: tarnegolim shehayu mechattetin bechevel deli, venifsak hachevel venishbar haddeli – meshallemin nezek shalem.
Bae rava: darsa al keli velo shevarattu, venitgalgel lemakom acher venishbar, mahu? batar meikkara azlinan – vegufeh hu, o dilma batar tevar mana azlina – utzerorot ninhu?
Tifshot leh midderabba – deamar rabba: zarak keli merosh haggag, uva acher ushevaro bemakkel – patur; deamrinan leh: mana tevira tevar! lerabba – peshita leh, lerava – mibbaya leh.
Ta shema: hiddus – eno muad. veyesh omrim: hare ze muad.
Hiddus salka datach?! ella lav hiddus vehittiz, uveha kamippalgi – demar savar: batar meikkara azlinan, umar savar: batar tevar mena azlinan?
La;

a: Behittiz tzerorot, uviflugeta desomchos verabbanan kamippalgi.
Ta shema: tarnegolin shehayu mechattetin bechevel deli, venifsak hachevel venishbar haddeli – meshallemin nezek shalem. shema minna, batar meikkara azlinan! targema achevel.
Veha chevel meshunne hu! demaus belisha: veha "nishbar deli" katane! ella somchos hi, deamar: tzerorot – nezek shalem meshallem.
I somchos, ema sefa: nittaz mimmennu shever, venafal al keli acher ushevarah – al harishon meshallem nezek shalem, veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek. vei somchos, mi it leh chatzi nezek?
Vechi tema shane leh lesomchos ben nezek kocho lechoach kocho; veella ha devae rav ashe: koach kocho lesomchos, kechocho dame o lav kechocho dame?
Tifshot leh delav kechocho dame!
Ella lav rabbanan hi? shema minna batar meikkara azlinan!
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye: dekaazel minneh minneh.

Bae rava: chatzi nezek tzerorot – miggufo meshallem, o mealiyyay meshallem? miggufo meshallem – dela ashkechan chatzi nezek dimshallem mealiyyay, o dilma mealiyyay meshallem – dela ashkechan keorcheh dimshallem miggufeh?
Ta shema: hiddus – eno muad. veyesh omrim: hare ze muad. hiddus salka datach?! ella lav hiddus vehittiz,
Uveha kamippalgi: man deamar eno muad – kasavar miggufo meshallem, uman deamar muad – kasavar mealiyyay meshallem?
La; biflugeta desomchos verabbanan kamippalgi.
Ta shema: hakkelev shennatal charara vehalach legadish, veachal hacharara vehidlik et haggadish – al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem, veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek.
May tama – lav mishshum dehavya lehu tzerorot? vetane ala: meshallem chatzi nezek – miggufo!
Vetisbera?! lerabbi elazar – nezek shalem miggufeh mi ashkechan?
Ella kegon deshanni beha gachelet, verabbi elazar savar la kerabbi tarfon, deamar: meshunne keren bachatzar hannizzak, nezek shalem meshallem.
Vela hi; may tama mokmat la kerabbi tarfon – mishshum nezek shalem?
Rabbi elazar savar kesomchos, deamar: tzerorot – nezek shalem meshallem; vesavar la kerabbi yehuda, deamar: tzad tammut bimkomah omedet. vechi katane miggufo – atztzad tammut.
Amar leh rav samma bereh derav ashe leravina: emor deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda, betam venaasa muad; bemuad mittechillato
b: Mi shamat leh?
Ella ki kaamar rabbi elazar nezek shalem – kegon deiyyayad; uveha kamippalgi – mar savar yesh haadaa litzrorot, umar savar en haadaa litzrorot.
Ella ha devae rava: yesh haadaa litzrorot, o en haadaa litzrorot? i lerabbanan – en haadaa litzrorot, i lerabbi elazar – yesh haadaa litzrorot!
Amar lach rava: ki mibbaya li ledidi, allibba derabbanan difligi aleh desomchos; aval hacha, ben lerabbanan ben lerabbi elazar – kesomchos sevira lehu, deamar: tzerorot – nezek shalem meshallem.
Vetama may amur rabbanan chatzi nezek – deshanni vela iyyayad; uviflugeta derabbi tarfon verabbanan kamippalgi.
Emor deshamat leh lerabbi tarfon – nezek shalem; miggufo mi shamat leh?
In; mehecha mayyte la – mikkeren mershut harabbim;
Dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.
Veha rabbi tarfon let leh "dayyo"!
Ki let leh "dayyo" – hecha demipperich kal vachomer; hecha dela mipperich kal vachomer – it leh "dayyo".
Gufa – bae rava: yesh haadaa litzrorot, o en haadaa litzrorot? lekeren medammenan leh, o dilma tolada deregel hu?
Ta shema: hiddus – eno muad. veyesh omrim: hare ze muad. hiddus salka datach?! ella hiddus vehittiz.
May, lav kegon daavad telata zimne – uveha kamippalgi: mar savar yesh haadaa, umar savar en haadaa? la, bechad zimna; uviflugeta desomchos verabbanan kamippalgi.

Ta shema: behema shehetila gelalim leissa, rav yehuda omer: meshallem nezek shalem, verabbi elazar omer: chatzi nezek. may, lav kegon daavad telata zimne – uveha kamippalgi: mar savar yesh haadaa, umar savar en haadaa?
La; bechad zimna, uviflugeta desomchos verabbanan kamippalgi. veha meshunne hu! didchik leh alma.
Velema rav yehuda: halacha kesomchos, velema rabbi elazar: halacha kerabbanan! gelalim itztericha leh; salka datach amena, hoil uvatar gufeh geririn – kegufeh dame; ka mashma lan.

Ta shema, detane rame bar yechezkel: tarnegol shehoshit rosho laavir keli zechuchit, vetaka bo ushevaro – meshallem nezek shalem. veamar rav yosef, amri be rav: sus shetztzanaf vachamor shennaar, veshibber et hakkelim – meshallem chatzi nezek.
May, lav kegon daavad telata zimne –

a: Uveha kamippalgi: mar savar yesh haadaa, umar savar en haadaa?
La; bechad zimna, uviflugeta desomchos verabbanan kamippalgi. veha meshunne hu! deit beh bizrane.
Bae rav ashe: yesh shinnuy litzrorot lirvia nezek, o en shinnuy litzrorot lirvia nezek?
Tifshot leh midderava, devae rava: yesh haadaa litzrorot, o en haadaa litzrorot? mikkelal deen shinnuy.
Dilma rava "im timtze lomar" kaamar – im timtze lomar en shinnuy, yesh haadaa, o en haadaa? teku.
Bae rav ashe: koach kocho lesomchos, kechocho dame o la?
Mi gemir halacha – umoke la bechoach kocho, o dilma la gemir halacha kelal? teku.
Hayta mevaetet, o shehayu tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha, veshavra et hakkelim – meshallem chatzi nezek. ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar?

Hayta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah, o tzerorot keorchayyhu – meshallem chatzi nezek, verabbanan hi; o dilma, hayta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah, o tzerorot mechamat biut – meshallem chatzi nezek, ha ki orcheh – meshallem nezek shalem, umanni – somchos hi?
Ta shema missefa: darsa al hakkeli ushevarattu, venafal hashshever al keli acher ushevaro – al harishon meshallem nezek shalem, veal haacharon chatzi nezek. vei somchos, mi it leh chatzi nezek?
Vechi tema "rishon" – rishon lehattaza, vesheni" – sheni lehattaza; veshane leh lesomchos ben kocho lechoach kocho;
Ella ha devae rav ashe: koach kocho lesomchos, kechocho dame o lav kechocho dame? tifshot leh delav kechocho dame!
Rav ashe kerabbanan moke la, uvae la hachi – hayta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah, o tzerorot keorchayyhu – chatzi nezek. ha mechamat biut – revia nezek, veyesh shinnuy;
O dilma, hayta mevaetet vehizzika beviutah, o tzerorot mechamat biut – chatzi nezek, veen shinnuy? teku.

Bae minneh rabbi abba bar memel merabbi amme, veamri la merabbi chiyyay bar abba: hayta mehallechet bemakom shei efshar lah ella im ken menattezet, uviata vehittiza vehizzika, mahu? kevan dei efshar la – orchay hu; o dilma, hasheta miha mechamat biut kamnatteza tzerorot? teku.

Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: hayta mehallechet birshut harabbim, uviata vehittiza vehizzika, mahu? lekeren medammenan leh – vechayyevet, o dilma tolada deregel hu – ufetura? amar leh: mistabbera, tolada deregel hu.
Hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut hayyachid, mahu? amar leh: akira en kan, hannacha yesh kan?!

Etiveh: hayta mehallechet badderech vehittiza, ben birshut hayyachid ben birshut harabbim – chayyayv. may, lav hittiza birshut harabbim, vehizzika birshut harabbim? la, hittiza birshut harabbim, vehizzika birshut hayyachid. vehaamrat: akira en kan, hannacha yesh kan! amar leh: hadari bi.

Etiveh: darsa al hakkeli ushevarattu, venafal hashshever al keli acher ushevaro – al harishon meshallem nezek shalem, veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek. vetane ala: bamme devarim amurim – birshut hannizzak, aval birshut harabbim – al harishon petura veal haacharon chayyevet. may, lav hittiza birshut harabbim, vehizzika birshut harabbim?
Lo, hittiza birshut harabbim vehizzika birshut hayyachid. vehaamrat akira en kan hannacha yesh kan! amar leh: hadari bi.
Ini?!
b: Vehaamar rabbi yochanan: en chatzi nezek chaluk lo lirshut hayyachid velo lirshut harabbim. may, lav hittiza birshut harabbim, vehizzika birshut harabbim? la; hittiza birshut harabbim, vehizzika birshut hayyachid.
Vehaamrat: akira en kan, hannacha yesh kan! amar leh: hadari bi. ibbaet ema: ki amar rabbi yochanan – akaran.

Yatev rabbi yehuda nesia verabbi oshaya akkila derabbi yehuda, nefak milleta mibbenayyhu: kishkesha biznavah, mahu? amar leh iddach: vechi yochazenna biznavah veyelech?! i hachi, keren name, nema: vechi yochazenna bekeren veyelech?!
Hachi hasheta?! keren lav orcheh, ha orchay.
Vechi meachar deorchay, may mibbaya leh? kishkush yattira mibbaya leh.
Bae rav ena: kishkesha beammatah mahu? mi amrinan midde dehave akkeren – keren lav yitzra katakef leh? hacha name la shena; o dilma, keren kauonato lehazzik, ha en kauonatah lehazzik? teku.
Hattarnegolin muadin lehallech kedarkan uleshabber vechulei. amar rav huna: lo shanu ella shennikshar meelav, aval kesharo adam – chayyayv.
Nikshar meelav – man chayyayv? ilema baal haddelil, hechi dame? i deatzneeh – anus hu! vei la atzneeh – poshea hu!
Ella chayyayv baal tarnegol? may shena kulleh nezek dela – dichtiv: "ki yiftach ish bor" – velo shor bor; chatzi nezek name, "ish bor" – velo shor bor!
Ella matnitin bidaddeyeh addoye. vechi ittemar derav huna – bealma ittemar. delil hefker – amar rav huna: nikshar meelav – patur, kesharo adam – chayyayv.
Mishshum may chayyayv? amar rav huna bar manoach: mishshum boro hammitgalgel beragle adam uveragle vehema.

Mishna ketzad hashshen muedet? leechol et harauy lah. habbehema muedet leechol perot virakot. achla kesut o chelim – meshallem chatzi nezek. bamme devarim amurim – birshut hannizzak, aval birshut harabbim – patur.
Veim nehenet – meshallemet ma shennehenet.

Ketzad meshallemet ma shennehenet? achla mittoch harchava – meshallemet ma shennehenet, mitztzidde harchava – meshallemet ma shehizzika. mippetach hachanut – meshallemet ma shennehenet, mittoch hachanut – meshallemet ma shehizzika.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah – ketzad? behema shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak, veachla ochalin haruyin lah veshatta mashkin haruyin lah – meshallem nezek shalem. vechen chayya shennichnesa lachatzar hannizzak, vetarfa behema veachla basar – meshallem nezek shalem.

Ufara sheachla seorin, vachamor sheachal karshinin, vechelev shellikkek et hashshemen, vachazir sheachal chaticha shel basar – meshallemin nezek shalem. amar rav pappa, hasheta deamrat: kol midde delav orcheh, veachla leh al yede haddechak – shemeh achila; hay shunnara daachal tamre, vachamara daachayl binita – meshallem nezek shalem.

Hahu chamra daachal nahama ufalleseh lesalla, chayyeyveh rav yehuda leshallem nezek shalem annahama, veassalla chatzi nezek. veammay? kevan deorcheh lemechal nahama – orcheh name lefallose salla! daachal vahadar palles.
Ufat orcheh hu?! ureminhu: achla pat uvasar vetavshil – meshallem chatzi nezek. may, lav bivhema? lo, bechayya.
Chayya – basar orcheh hu! demitteve. veibbaet ema: betavya. veibbaet ema: leolam bivhema, uvefatura.

a: Hahu barcha dachaza lifta appumma dedanna, sarech selek, achla lelifta vetavreh ledanna. chayyeyveh rava allifta veaddanna nezek shalem. may tama? kevan deorcheh lemechal lifta, orcheh name lesaroche ulemislak.
Amar ilfa: behema birshut harabbim, ufashta tzavvarah veachla meal gabbe chavertah – chayyevet. may tama? gabbe chavertah – kachatzar hannizzak dame.
Lema mesayyay leh: hayta kuppato mufeshelet laachorav, ufashta tzavvarah veachla mimmennu – chayyevet. kidamar rava – bekofetzet, hacha name bekofetzet.
