Vehecha ittemar derava? aha – deamar rabbi oshaya: behema birshut harabbim; halcha veachla – petura, amda veachla – chayyevet. may shena halcha – deorcheh hu, amda name orcheh hu! amar rava: bekofetzet.
Bae rabbi zera: mitgalgel mahu? hechi dame? kegon dekayyma amir birshut hayyachid – veka mitgalgal veate mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim. may?

Ta shema, detane rabbi chiyyay: massoy, miktzato bifnim umiktzato bachutz; achla bifnim – chayyevet, achla bachutz – petura. may, lav mitgalgal veate? la, ema: achla – al ma shebbifnim chayyevet, al ma shebbachutz petura.
Ibbaet ema: ki kaamar rabbi chiyyay – biftila deaspasta.
Achla kesut vechulei.
Aheyay? amar rav: akkullehu. may tama? kol hameshanne, uva acher veshinna bo – patur.
Ushemuel amar: lo shanu ella perot virakot, aval kesut vechelim – chayyevet.

Vechen amar resh lakish: akkullehu. veazda resh lakish letameh, deamar resh lakish: shete farot birshut harabbim, achat revutza veachat mehallechet; baata mehallechet barvutza – petura, revutza bammehallechet – chayyevet.
Verabbi yochanan amar: lo shanu ella perot virakot, aval kesut vechelim – chayyevet.
Lema rabbi yochanan let leh deresh lakish – afillu bishte farot? la, leolam it leh; kesut – avdi inashe demannechi gelime umittafchi, aval behema – lav orcha.
Veim nehenet – meshallemet vechulei. vechamma? rabba amar: deme amir. rava amar: deme seorim bezol.
Tanya kevoteh derabba, tanya kevoteh derava. tanya kevoteh derabba – rabbi shimon ben yochay amar: en meshallemet ella deme amir bilvad.

Tanya kevoteh derava – im nehenet, meshallemet ma shennehenet. ketzad? achla kav o kabbayim – en omrim teshallem demehen, ella omdin kamma adam rotze lehaachil livhemto davar harauy lah, af al pi sheeno ragil. lefichach, achla chittin o davar hara lah – petura.

Amar leh rav chisda lerame bar chama: la havet gabban beureta bitchuma, deibbaya lan mille mealleyayta. amar: may mille mealleyayta? amar leh: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, o en tzarich?
Hechi dame? illema bechatzer dela kayyma leagra, vegavra dela avid lemegar – ze lo nehene veze lo chaser! ella bechatzer dekayyma leagra, vegavra daavid lemegar – ze nehene veze chaser!
La tzericha – bechatzer dela kayyma leagra, vegavra daavid lemegar; may? matze amar leh: may chassartaych? o dilma, matze amar:
b: Ha ithanit!
Amar leh: matnitin hi. he matnitin? amar leh: lechi teshammesh li. shekal sudareh kerach leh. amar leh: im nehenet – meshallemet ma shennehenet.
Amar rava: kamma la chale vela margesh gavra demareh sayyeyeh – deaf al gav dela dame lematnitin, kabbela minneh. hay ze nehene veze chaser, vehay ze nehene veze lo chaser hu!
Verame bar chama – setam perot birshut harabbim, afkore mafkar lehu.
Tenan: hammakkif chavero mishshalosh ruchotav, vegadar et harishona veet hashsheniyya veet hashshelishit – en mechayyeyvin oto. ha reviit – mechayyeyvin oto;
Shema minna: ze nehene veze lo chaser – chayyayv! shane hatam, daamar leh: at geramt li hekkefa yattira.
Ta shema, amar rabbi yose: im amad nikkaf vegadar et harviit – megalgelin alav et hakkol. tama degadar nikkaf, ha makkif – patur;
Shema minna, ze nehene veze lo chaser – patur! shane hatam, deamar leh: ledidi saggi li bintira bar zuza.
Ta shema: habbayit vehaaliyyay shel shenayim, shennaflu; amar baal haaliyyay levaal habbayit livnot, vehu eno rotze – hare baal haaliyyay bone bayit veyoshev bah, ad sheyyitten lo yetziotav.
Yetziotav hu dimchayyev leh baal habbayit, ha secharo – la; shema minna, ze nehene veze lo chaser – patur! shane hatam, deveta laaliyyay mishtabad.

Ta shema, rabbi yehuda omer: af ze haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. shema minna: ze nehene veze lo chaser – chayyayv! shane hatam, mishshum shachrurita deashyayta.

Shallechuha be rabbi amme, amar: vechi ma asa lo, uma chissero, uma hizziko? rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: nityayshshev baddavar. hadar shallechuha kammeh derabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar: kulleh hay shalchu li veazli! illu ashkachi ba tama, la shalachna lehu?!
Ittemar, rav kahana amar rabbi yochanan: eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar. rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: tzarich lehaalot lo sachar.
Amar rav pappa: ha derabbi avahu – lav beferush ittemar, ella mikkelala ittemar. ditnan: natal even o kora shel hekdesh – hare ze lo maal.
Netanah lachavero – hu maal, vachavero lo maal. benaah letoch beto – hare ze lo maal, ad sheyyadur tachteha shave peruta.
Veamar shemuel: vehu shehinnichah al pi arubba.
Veyatev rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan, vekaamar mishshemeh dishmuel: zot omeret, haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – tzarich lehaalot lo sachar; ushetek leh.
Ihu savar – middishtek, mode leh. vela hi, ashgoche la ashgach beh.
Kidrabba, deamar rabba: hekdesh shello middaat –

a: Kehedyot middaat dame.
Shelach leh rabbi abba bar zavda lemare bar mar, bei minneh merav huna: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato, tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, o la? addehachi – nach nafsheh derav huna.

Amar leh rabba bar rav huna, hachi amar abba mari mishshemeh derav: eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, vehassocher bayit meruven – maale sachar leshimon. shimon may avidteh? hachi kaamar: nimtza habbayit shel shimon – maale lo sachar.
Tarte?! ha – dekayyma leagra, ha – dela kayyma leagra.

Ittemar name: amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rav, veamri la amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rav huna: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – eno tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, vehassocher bayit mibbene hair – maale sachar labbealim. bealim may avidtayyhu? hachi kaamar: nimtzeu lo bealim – maalin lahen sachar.
Tarte?! ha dekayyma leagra, ha dela kayyma leagra.

Amar rav sechora amar rav huna amar rav: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato – en tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, mishshum shenneemar: "usheiyya yukkat shaar". amar mar bar rav ashe: ledidi chaze leh, umenaggach ki tora. rav yosef amar: beta meyatteva – yatev.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu – deka mishtammash beh betzive vetivna.

Hahu gavra divna appadna akkilkalta deyatme. agbeye rav nachman leappadneh minneh. lema kasavar rav nachman: haddar bachatzar chavero shello middato, tzarich lehaalot lo sachar? hahu – meikkara karmenae havo dayyri beh, veyahavi lehu leyatme davar muat. amar leh: zil payyeysinhu leyatme, vela ashgach. agbeye rav nachman leappadneh minneh.
Ketzad meshallemet ma shennehenet vechulei. amar rav: uvemachzeret. ushemuel amar: afillu machzeret name patur.
Velishmuel – hechi mashkachat la dimchayyev? kegon dishvakta lirchava, vaazala vekama betzidde rechava.

Veikka dematne leha shemata beappe nafshah: machzeret – rav amar: chayyevet, ushemuel amar: petura. velishmuel, "meshallemet ma shehizzika" hechi mashkachat la dimchayyeyva? kegon dishvaka lirchava, vaazala vekama betzidde rechava.
Metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak: mippetach hachanut – meshallemet ma shennehenet. hechi mashkachat la – peshita bemachzeret; vekaamar (mar) "ma shennehenet", ma shennehenet – in, ma shehizzika – la!
Hu motev la vehu mefarek la: dekayyma bekeren zavit.
Ikka deamri: machzeret – kulle alma la peligi dechayyevet. ki peligi, bemaktze makom mershuto lirshut harabbim.
Vehachi ittemar, amar rav: lo shanu ella machzeret, aval maktze makom mershuto lirshut harabbim – petura. ushemuel amar: afillu maktze makom mershuto lirshut harabbim – chayyevet.
Lema bevor birshuto kamippalgi – rav deamar patur, kasavar: bor birshuto – chayyayv.
Ushemuel deamar chayyayv, kasavar: bor birshuto – patur?
Amar lecha rav, leolam ema lach:
b: Bealma – bor birshuto patur; veshane hacha, deamar: lav kol keminach dimkarvat lehu leferotach lirshut harabbim, umechayyeyvat lehu letoray.
Ushemuel amar: bealma – bor birshuto chayyayv; devishlama bor, ikka lememar lav addateh; ella perot, mi ikka lememar lav addateh?! ha chaze lehu!

Lema machzeret tannae hi – detanya: achla mittoch harchava – meshallemet ma shennehenet, mitztzidde harchava – meshallemet ma shehizzika; divre rabbi meir verabbi yehuda. rabbi yose verabbi elazar omrim: en darkah leechol, ella lehallech.
Rabbi yose hayeynu tanna kamma! ella machzeret ikka benayyhu – tanna kamma savar: machzeret name – meshallem ma shennehenet, verabbi yose savar: meshallemet ma shehizzika.

La; dechulle alma, machzeret – i kerav, i kishmuel. vehacha bevier bisde acher" ka mippalgi – mar savar: "uvier bisde acher" – velo birshut harabbim; umar savar: "uvier bisde acher" – velo birshut hammazzik.
Birshut hammazzik – lema: perach birshuti may bae? ella deilfa verabbi oshaya ikka benayyhu.

Mishna hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag, veshavru et hakkelim – meshallem nezek shalem, mippene shehen muadin. hakkelev shennatal charara vehalach legadish, achal hacharara vehidlik haggadish – al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem, veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek.
Gemara tama dekaftzu, ha naflu – patur; alma kasavar: techillato bifshia vesofo beones – patur.

Tanya name hachi: hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag veshavru et hakkelim – meshallem nezek shalem. naflu – peturin. hanicha leman deamar: techillato bifshia vesofo beones – patur, ella leman deamar: chayyayv, may ikka lememar?
Kegon dimkarvi kelim legabbe chotel – dechi kaftzi bikfitza, la nafli alayyhu; vaafillu techillato bifshia lekka.

Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: peamim sheafillu naflu name chayyayv – mashkachat la bechotel raua. may nihu – deibbei leh leassoke data denafyli[10] arche? sof sof, la neful arche – uneful inhu; techillato bifshia vesofo beones hu! la tzericha, bechotel tzar.
Tanu rabbanan: hakkelev vehaggedi sheddillegu mimmatta lemala – peturin. millemala lematta – chayyayvin. adam vetarnegol sheddillegu; ben millemala lematta, ben millematta lemala – chayyayvin.

a: Vehatanya: hakkelev vehaggedi sheddillegu; ben millemala lematta, ben millematta lemala – peturin! targema rav pappa: deafech mefach – kalba bizkira vegadya bisricha. i hachi, ammay peturim? patur minnezek shalem, vechayyayvin bachatzi nezek.
Hakkelev shennatal.
Ittemar, rabbi yochanan amar: ishsho – mishshum chitztzav. veresh lakish amar: ishsho – mishshum mamono.

Veresh lakish – may tama la amar kerabbi yochanan? amar lach: chitztzav – mikkocho kaazli, hay – la mikkocho kaazel. verabbi yochanan – may tama la amar keresh lakish? amar lach: mamona – it beh mammasha, ha – let beh mammasha.
Tenan: hakkelev shennatal charara kulei. bishlama leman deamar: ishsho mishshum chitztzav – chitztzav dechelev hu;
Ella leman deamar: ishsho mishshum mamono – hay esh, lav mamono devaal kelev hu!
Amar lach resh lakish: hacha bemay askinan – deaddeyeh addoye; deal charara meshallem nezek shalem, veal makom gachelet meshallem chatzi nezek, veal gadish kulle patur.
Verabbi yochanan – deannecha annoche; al charara veal mekom gachelet meshallem nezek shalem, veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek.

Ta shema: gamal taun pishtan veavar birshut harabbim; nichnesa pishtano letoch hachanut (vedalku), [vedalka] benero shel chenvoni, vehidlik et habbira – baal gamal chayyayv. hinniach chenvoni nero mibbachutz – chenvoni chayyayv. rabbi yehuda omer: bener chanukka – patur.

Bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav – chitztzav degamal hu. ella leman deamar mishshum mamono – hay esh, lav mamona devaal gamal hu! amar lach resh lakish: hacha bemay askinan – bimsachsechet kol habbira kullah.
I hachi, ema sefa: im hinniach chenvoni nero mibbachutz – chenvoni chayyayv. vei bimsachsechet – ammay chayyayv? besheamda.
Amda vesichsecha – kol shekken dechenvoni patur uvaal gamal chayyayv! amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav ika: hacha bemay askinan – kegon sheamda lehattil memeha;
b: Resha – baal gamal chayyayv, dela ibbei leh leapposhe bitina. sefa – chenvoni chayyayv, dela ibbei leh leannoche nero meabbaray.
Ta shema: hammadlik et haggadish, vehaya gedi kafut lo, veeved samuch lo venisraf immo – chayyayv. eved kafut lo, ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo – patur.
Bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav – mishshum hachi patur. ella leman deamar ishsho mishshum mamono, ammay patur? illu ketal toreh avda, hachi name dela michayyayv?!
Amar lecha rabbi shimon ben lakish: hacha bemay askinan – keshehitztzit begufo shel eved, dekam leh bidrabba minneh.
I hachi, may lememra? la tzericha – bigdi dechad, veeved dechad.
Ta shema: hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh shote vekatan – patur middine adam, vechayyayv bedine shamayim.
Bishlama leman deamar ishsho mishshum chitztzav – chitztzav decheresh hu. ella leman deamar ishsho mishshum mamono – illu masar shoro lecheresh shote vekatan, hachi name dela michayyayv?!
Ha ittemar ala, amar resh lakish mishshemeh dechizkiyya: lo shanu ella keshemmasar lo gachelet, velibbah; aval masar lo shalhevet – chayyayv. may tama? bari hezzeka.
Verabbi yochanan amar: afillu shalhevet – patur, kasavar: tzevata decheresh ka garem; la michayyayv ad demasar leh gevoza, silta usheraga.
Amar rava: kera umatnita mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan. kera – dichtiv: "ki tetze esh" – tetze meatzmah, "yeshallem hammavir et habbeera" – shema minna ishsho mishshum chitztzav.
Matnita – detanya: patach hakkatuv
